programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Scottish Premiership / Fudbal - Škotski Premiership
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship in its first season has set out in 1890. years and has already been set up by one rarity. Two teams then divided the champion title because of the same number of points at the end of the season. These were today the world-famous Glasgov Rangers, a team with more than 50 championship titles and today a relatively unknown club Dumbarton. The League itself has changed the names and format in a couple of occasions, but since 2013. it is officially called "Scottish Professional Football League" and is the highest scottish football rank. The League is also marked by one of the largest derbies in the history of football between the two Glasgovske teams of Celtic and Rangers. / Škotsko fudbalsko prvenstvo u svoju prvu sezonu su krenuli 1890. godine i već tada je postavljen jedan raritet. Dve ekipe su tada podijelile šampionsku titulu zbog istog broja bodova na kraju sezone. To su bili danas svjetski poznati Glazgov Rendžersi, ekipa sa više od 50 šampionskih titula i danas relativno nepoznati klub Dumbarton. Sama liga je kroz godine u par navrata mijenjala nazive i format, no od 2013. se službeno zove "Scottish Professional Football League" i najviši je rang škotskog fudbala. Ligu isto obilježava jedan od najvećih derbija u istoriji fudbala između dve glazgovske ekipe Seltika i Rendžersa.

Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - French League / Fudbal - Francuska liga
programme.desc: Ligue 1 The first is the French professional football league that has 20 teams in the fight for the title of France champions. It was founded in 1932. years and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The most trophy club with ten won titles is AS Saint Etienne but the "green" on the new title are waiting since 1981. years and the time of the Great Michel Platini. The encounters of the French league are an unavoidable event for every lover of this magnificent game. / Ligue 1 prva je francuska profesionalna fudbalska liga koja broji 20 ekipa u borbi za titulom prvaka Francuske. Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcjenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali "Zeleni" na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga

The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Ivaylo Yordanov / Зала на славата: Ивайло Йорданов
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Land / Проект "Земя"
programme.desc: Review of geo -engineering projects presented so far: combating air pollution, global warming, carbon dioxide emissions focus the interest of scientists who look at all options that can save us from problems. / Преглед на геоинженерните проекти, представени досега: борбата със замърсяването на въздуха, глобалното затопляне, емисиите въглероден двуокис фокусират интереса на учените, които разглеждат всички варианти, които могат да ни спасят от проблемите.

programme.desc: Eran's father is mayor and warns his son to be careful about what kind of friends he communicates. Investigator David meets Eran and realizes that he is not at school. He is lying to him for temperature. As he takes him home, they talk. Chino warns David that on the news, he was shown how the father of one of the children he investigated was beaten. In fact, he defended the son from the aggressive father. They remove it. Eran tells the Unicorn that Davidi saw him in Dor's house. So he proposes to kill him, but unicorn refuses and only advises him to get rid of the gun. Davidi realizes that Itamar is sleeping in the pizzeria because he is afraid of his father. His wife, Miri, worries that Davidi is beginning to lose control. / Бащата на Еран е кмет и предупреждава сина си да внимава с какви приятели общува. Чино предупреждава Давиди, че по новините са го показали как бие бащата на едно от децата, които разследва. А всъщност той е защитавал сина от агресивния баща. Отстраняват го. Еран казва на Еднорога, че Давиди го е видял в къщата на Дор. Затова предлага да го убият, но Еднорога отказва и го съветва само да се отърве от пистолета. Давиди разбира, че Итамар спи в пицарията, защото се страхува от баща си. Веднъж вече го е спасявал от пияния му баща. А сега завежда момчето в дома си. programme.title: Atlas - Borussia M, Football, German Cup / Atlas - Borussia M, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cups dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

Zakon je imao ogroman utjecaj na svijet ženskog sporta u kojem je i danas primjetna nejednakost među spolovima vezano uz zaradu, medijsku pokrivenost te vodeće pozicije u klubovima. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Rudeš - Orient, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 3rd round / Rudeš - Orijent, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 3. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Istria 1961 - Gorica, SuperSport HNL 2025/2026, 5th round / Istra 1961 - Gorica, SuperSport HNL 2025./2026., 5. kolo
programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. By 2022, the league was named the first Croatian football league. The top ten football clubs from Croatia participate in the Supersport HNL. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try in the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -placed entering the 2nd round of qualifying for the UEFA European Conference League ... / Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.title: Dugo Selo - Sesvete, Qualifications for the EHF European League 2025/2026 / Dugo Selo - Sesvete, Kvalifikacije za EHF Europsku ligu 2025./2026
programme.desc: Handball - EHF European Championship Qualifiers - (Sport. Program) The performance in the final tournament of the best Teams of the Old Continent have all European national teams except the hosts and the last European champion. So the qualifications offer numerous interesting and tense matches through two qualifications phases. In the first phase, there are teams that have a lower ranking and are arranged in groups of four teams where only the winner passes in the next phase. The second phase of qualification includes the best European representative teams and the winners of the group first phase. The first two places in each group in the second phase are made by placement to the final tournament. Other positions are divided among the best-placed third teams from the group ... / Handball - EHF European Championship Qualifiers - (sport. program) Nastup u kvalifikacijama za završni turnir najboljih momčadi starog kontinenta imaju sve europske reprezentacije osim domaćina i posljednjeg europskog prvaka. Tako da kvalifikacije nude brojne zanimljive i napete utakmice kroz dvije kvalifikacijske faze. U prvoj fazi se nalaze momčadi koje imaju niži ranking te su raspoređene u skupine po četiri ekipe gdje samo pobjednik prolazi u narednu fazu. Druga faza kvalifikacija uključuje najbolje europske reprezentativne timove te pobjednike skupina prve faze. Prva dva mjesta u svakoj grupi u drugoj fazi donose plasman na završni turnir. Ostale pozicije se dijele među najbolje plasiranim trećim ekipama iz skupina...

programme.title: Dugo Selo - Sesvete, Qualifications for the EHF European League 2025/2026 / Dugo Selo - Sesvete, Kvalifikacije za EHF Europsku ligu 2025./2026
programme.desc: Handball - EHF European Championship Qualifiers - (Sport. Program) The performance in the final tournament of the best Teams of the Old Continent have all European national teams except the hosts and the last European champion. So the qualifications offer numerous interesting and tense matches through two qualifications phases. In the first phase, there are teams that have a lower ranking and are arranged in groups of four teams where only the winner passes in the next phase. The second phase of qualification includes the best European representative teams and the winners of the group first phase. The first two places in each group in the second phase are made by placement to the final tournament. Other positions are divided among the best-placed third teams from the group ... / Handball - EHF European Championship Qualifiers - (sport. program) Nastup u kvalifikacijama za završni turnir najboljih momčadi starog kontinenta imaju sve europske reprezentacije osim domaćina i posljednjeg europskog prvaka. Tako da kvalifikacije nude brojne zanimljive i napete utakmice kroz dvije kvalifikacijske faze. U prvoj fazi se nalaze momčadi koje imaju niži ranking te su raspoređene u skupine po četiri ekipe gdje samo pobjednik prolazi u narednu fazu. Druga faza kvalifikacija uključuje najbolje europske reprezentativne timove te pobjednike skupina prve faze. Prva dva mjesta u svakoj grupi u drugoj fazi donose plasman na završni turnir. Ostale pozicije se dijele među najbolje plasiranim trećim ekipama iz skupina...

Sie kann verunreinigt sein: durch Feinstaub, Smog oder Zigarettenrauch. Sie lasst sich aber auch fur unsere Gesundheit nutzen, zum Beispiel mit der so genannten Bienenstocklufttherapie.Welche Luft ist gut fur uns? Wo hat sich die Luftqualitat verbessert? Und was tun gegen schlechte Luft? In dieser Ausgabe von "Quarks" zeigt Thomas Ranft, wie Tornados entstehen, was passiert, wenn man mit dem Rauchen aufhort, und was der Luftdruck mit wetterfuhligen Menschen macht. AuSSerdem: Welche Windstarke kann man im Windkanal gerade noch aushalten? Wie geht richtiges Atmen? Und: Wie gut ist eigentlich die Luft im Auto?

programme.title: Der Kroatien-Krimi
programme.desc: The body of a drowned girl is found in the industrial port of Split. For Branka Maric (Neda Rahmanian) there is no doubt that the twelfth year was the victim of a crime. Traces on her wrist show that the drowned person was tied up beforehand - possibly from smugglers who took the girls and sell them to their tormentors. Branka whistles on the instructions to undergo the investigation of the department organized crime. The commissioner has no idea how dangerous the case is for her when she further detects on her own. During the night, a bomb explodes on the yacht of her beloved Lado (Aleksandar Jovanovic) - with Branka on board! In order to clear up the attack, the homicide commission receives unpleasant support from the capital: the successful but unpopular commissioner Stascha Novak (Jasmin Gerat). With the spectacular case, she wants to continue her track record in order to force the burial request in Zagreb. The department in Split, however, absolutely liked that the case is drawn by the domestic power. Emil (Lenn Kudrjawizki) gathered into a Zwickmuhle: he and his colleague Borko (Kasem Hoxha) are supposed to let Stascha run into nothing. / Im Industriehafen von Split wird die Leiche eines ertrunkenen Madchens gefunden. Fur Branka Maric (Neda Rahmanian) gibt es keinen Zweifel, dass die Zwolfjahrige das Opfer eines Verbrechens wurde. Spuren an ihrem Handgelenk zeigen: Die Ertrunkene war vorher gefesselt - moglicherweise von Schleusern, die Madchen entfuhren und an ihre Peiniger verkaufen. Branka pfeift auf die Dienstanweisung, die Ermittlungen der Abteilung Organisierte Kriminalitat zu uberlassen. Wie gefahrlich der Fall fur sie ist, ahnt die Kommissarin nicht, als sie auf eigene Faust weiterermittelt. In der Nacht explodiert eine Bombe auf der Yacht ihres Geliebten Lado (Aleksandar Jovanovic) - mit Branka an Bord! Um das Attentat aufzuklaren, bekommt die Mordkommission unliebsame Unterstutzung aus der Hauptstadt: die erfolgreiche, aber bei ihren mannlichen Kollegen unbeliebte Kommissarin Stascha Novak (Jasmin Gerat). Sie will mit dem spektakularen Fall ihre Erfolgsbilanz fortschreiben, um in Zagreb die uberfallige Beforderung zu erzwingen. Das Dezernat in Split jedoch mochte unbedingt, dass der Fall von den heimischen Kraften gelost wird. Emil (Lenn Kudrjawizki) gerat in eine Zwickmuhle: Er und sein Kollege Borko (Kasem Hoxha) sollen Stascha ins Leere laufen lassen.

programme.title: In the sights of the gray Wolfe / Im Visier der grauen Wolfe
programme.desc: The so -called "wolf greeting", which the Turkische international Merih Demiral showed together with many fans during the 2024 EM in 2024, put the German public into turmoil. The movement of the "gray Wolfe" has built up an ultra -nationalist, racist and violent network in Germany, which extends deep into our society - with clear connections to organized crime. The organization and its environment forms one of the greatest extreme right -wing movements in Germany. The "gray Wolfe" consider Turkentum as a superior nationality and gradually hike German society. The well -used representation of the gray wolf ("Bozkurt") is actually a symbol from pre -Islamic times and is primarily concerned with a myth of origin of the Turkish people. In the 20th century, violent appeals of the first ultra -nationalist party of the Turkei (Milliyetçi Hareket Partisi - MHP) initially introduced the so -called "wolf greeting" as a distinguishing sign. / Der sogenannte "WolfsgruSS", den der turkische Nationalspieler Merih Demiral gemeinsam mit vielen Fans wahrend der EM 2024 auf dem Spielfeld zeigte, hat die deutsche Öffentlichkeit in Aufruhr versetzt. Die Bewegung der "Grauen Wolfe" hat in Deutschland ein ultranationalistisches, rassistisches und gewaltbereites Netzwerk aufgebaut, das aus der Turkei tief in unsere Gesellschaft reicht - mit deutlichen Verbindungen in die Organisierte Kriminalitat.Die Organisation und ihr Umfeld bildet eine der groSSten rechtsextremen Bewegungen in Deutschland. Die "Grauen Wolfe" betrachten das Turkentum als uberlegene Nationalitat und unterwandern sukzessive die deutsche Gesellschaft. programme.desc: Dieter Hallervorden - one of the last icons of German show culture, will be 90 years old on September 5, 2025. The last big fool of the republic. A life between salmon and trannies, between scandal and applause. The man behind "Nonstop Nonsens", behind "Didi - the double ganger", behind "honey in the head" - and behind a life's work that makes millions laugh. He is also one of the most controversial, uncomfortable and most contradictory artists in Germany. A crowd favorite that keeps teasing. The provocateur, who does not become a must, against the expectations of the spectators, against prejudices and - perhaps most - against himself. Get three own theater. Produces songs. Flies daring looping over his hometown. And continues to make headlines - most recently when he sued Chancellor Friedrich Merz for Ubler. Because Hallervorden still does not leave anything like that - neither in politics nor in life. His Berliner at home. His legendary private island in Brittany. He accompanies Hallervorden on rehearsals, when traveling, in front of appearances - and catches up moments in which even one like him can no longer avoid. For the first time, his family has their say in detail - directly, honestly, deeply personal. Nathalie Hallervorden - the daughter with Rotraud Schindler - and his significantly young son Johannes bring us the family man Hallervorden, whose values ​​and beliefs are not always compatible with those of their own generation. worked, argued, laughed and suffered. They draw the picture of a man who has been fighting for over seven decades - against everyone who did not trust him, thought he was free of talent. Against those who misunderstand him to this day or reduce it to his Didi role. The film grits deeply in the archives: 70 years of German show history come to life. Private recordings and TV shaft that no one has seen for decades. About a man who has not stopped rubbing to rub himself - in the world, in society, in itself. A film that explains why Dieter Hallervorden became what he is - and why he is still loved and yet avoided. / Dieter Hallervorden - eine der letzten Ikonen der deutschen Showkultur, wird am 5. September 2025 90 Jahre alt. Der letzte groSSe Narr der Republik. Ein Leben zwischen Lachsalven und Tranen, zwischen Skandal und Applaus. Der Mann hinter "Nonstop Nonsens", hinter "Didi - Der Doppelganger", hinter "Honig im Kopf" - und hinter einem Lebenswerk, das Millionen zum Lachen bringt. Er ist zugleich einer der streitbarsten, unbequemsten und widerspruchlichsten Kunstler Deutschlands. Ein Publikumsliebling, der immer wieder aneckt. Der Provokateur, der nicht mude wird, sich gegen die Erwartungen der Zuschauer, gegen Vorurteile und - vielleicht am meisten - gegen sich selbst zu stemmen.Mit 90 Jahren steht er noch immer auf der Buhne. Fuhrt drei eigene Theater. Produziert Songs. Fliegt waghalsige Looping uber seiner Heimatstadt. Und sorgt weiterhin fur Schlagzeilen - zuletzt, als er den Kanzler Friedrich Merz wegen ubler Nachrede verklagte. Denn Hallervorden lasst bis heute nichts einfach so stehen - weder in der Politik noch im Leben.Der Film offnet Turen, die bisher verschlossen waren: Seine Kunstlergarderobe. Sein Berliner Zuhause. Seine legendare Privatinsel in der Bretagne. Er begleitet Hallervorden bei Proben, auf Reisen, vor Auftritten - und fangt Momente ein, in denen selbst einer wie er nicht mehr ausweichen kann. Zum ersten Mal kommt seine Familie ausfuhrlich zu Wort - direkt, ehrlich, zutiefst personlich. Nathalie Hallervorden - die gemeinsame Tochter mit Rotraud Schindler - und sein deutlich jungerer Sohn Johannes bringen uns den Familienvater Hallervorden naher, dessen Werte und Überzeugungen nicht immer mit denen ihrer eigenen Generation kompatibel sind.Dazu kommen enge langjahrige und prominente Weggefahrten, Vertraute, Beobachter und seine Ehefrau Christiane - die Dieter Hallervorden so gut kennt wie kaum jemand sonst. Menschen, die mit ihm gearbeitet, gestritten, gelacht und gelitten haben. Sie zeichnen das Bild eines Mannes, der seit uber sieben Jahrzehnten kampft - gegen alle, die ihm nichts zutrauten, ihn fur talentfrei hielten, ihn ablehnten. Gegen die, die ihn bis heute missverstehen, verurteilen oder auf seine Didi-Rolle reduzieren.Der Film zeigt Hallervorden an den groSSen Wendepunkten seines bewegten Lebens: Von der Kindheit in Dessau uber die dramatische Flucht aus der DDR - samt dem nie ausgefuhrten Plan, den Regimefuhrer Walter Ulbricht zu ermorden -, uber den Aufstieg mit "Nonstop Nonsens", die Kinojahre mit Didi als Slapstick-Actionheld der 80er Jahre, die Skandale, die Ruckzuge, die Comebacks bis zum spaten Triumph als Charakterdarsteller in "Sein letztes Rennen" und "Honig im Kopf" - und daruber hinaus. Denn der Mann, der nie zur Ruhe kam, fuhrt bis heute drei Theater, produziert, spielt mehrere Rollen gleichzeitig und sorgt regelmaSSig fur Diskussionen - ob mit provokanten Buhnenstucken, politischen Songs oder aktuellen Eklats.Wer verstehen will, warum jemand, der einst ein Attentat auf das DDR-Regime plante, auch mit 90 noch politisch aneckt und seine Meinung lautstark ohne Rucksicht auf Verluste kundtut, bekommt hier Antworten: Warum er bis heute gegen jede Vernunft das altbewahrte immer wieder umschmeiSSt - und sich neu erfindet. Private Aufnahmen und TV-Schatze, die seit Jahrzehnten niemand mehr gesehen hat. Ein Film, der erklart, warum Dieter Hallervorden zu dem wurde, was er ist - und warum er bis heute so geliebt und doch gemieden wird.

programme.title: Sein letztes Rennen
programme.desc: Paul Averhoff was once a great marathon, a legend, winner of the gold medal in Sydney in 1958. Now, with far above 70, after repeated falling over his wife Margot, he pulls out of the familiar at home after many happily - also because daughter Birgit cannot boom, she jets as a flight attendant all over the world. The craft hour has to decide, the crucial question comes up: that should have been? In order not to fall into deep depression, Paul attracts his old racing shoes and begins to run in the park. Um nicht in tiefe Depression zu verfallen, zieht Paul seine alten Rennschuhe an und beginnt, im Park zu laufen. Anfangs schleppend und jammerlich, dann aber immer schneller. Seine Heim-Mitbewohner halten ihn fur verruckt, zumal er behauptet, fur den Berlin-Marathon zu trainieren und ihn auch gewinnen zu wollen.Als sich Margot dazu uberreden lasst, ihn wie fruher mit strenger Hand zu trainieren, und Paul in einem Rennen gegen den jungen Pfleger Tobias gewinnt, schlagt die Zuruckhaltung der Bewohner jedoch in Begeisterung um. programme.desc: The use of genetic engineering in agriculture is still controversial after almost 30 years. In addition to environmental concerns and the monopoly position of some fewer seed manufacturers, critics drove the long-term consequences to be tapped. In Europe, many consumers vehemently reject "genetic engineering on the plate". The cultivation of genetically connected plants has been cut in the EU, and in Austria they still have not come to the fields. The large agricultural -producing countries such as the USA, Canada, Brazil or India, on the other hand, rely flatly on it: worldwide generous plants are grown on around 200 million hectares of hectares. Minged into the genome, which means that plants become more resistant to climate extremes and males more resistance and their cultivation is less stressful. For some young farmers it is clear: in the future, agriculture does not have to contradict nature. After a few Durresommern, they were used more resistant NGT corn. USA correspondent Thomas Langpaul is on local inspection in Oklahoma. The state in the country's central Suden pays to the fuided wheat producers and is one of the hotspots of the American agricultural industry. In addition to wheat, corn, soy and cotton is grown on the huge farms that still rely on classic genetic engineering (GMO). But here too, a rethink begins, because the consequences of climate change - such as extreme dur periods, soil erosion and thus falling streak - also present the large companies with enormous challenges. In 2021, the government dares an experiment: the entire country is to be switched to biological agriculture. Instead of a gradual transition, import and use of synthetic dung agents and pesticides are banned almost over night. Within a few months, the harvesting carrier breaks down drastically, the food prices shoot into the high, protests shocks the country. Correspondent Benedict Feichtner meets peasant families who have lost their livelihood as a result of the abrupt change. In the meantime, imported seeds and chemical sprays have been approved again, but at the same time a kind of countermovement has arisen: in training centers, small farmers learn today how they can sustainably operate organic farming using traditional and regenerative methods and thus escape the dependency on the large seed corporations. / Der Einsatz von Gentechnik in der Landwirtschaft ist - nach inzwischen fast 30 Jahren - immer noch umstritten. Kritiker fuhren neben Umweltbedenken und der Monopolstellung einiger weniger Saatgut-Hersteller vor allem die schwer abzuschatzenden Langzeitfolgen ins Treffen. In Europa lehnen viele Verbraucher "Gentechnik am Teller" vehement ab. Der Anbau gentechnisch veranderter Pflanzen ist in der EU stark eingeschrankt, in Österreich kommen sie bis heute nicht auf die Felder. Die groSSen agrarproduzierenden Lander wie die USA, Kanada, Brasilien oder auch Indien setzen hingegen flachendeckend darauf: weltweit werden auf rund 200 Millionen Hektar genmodifizierte Pflanzen angebaut.In Belgien spricht Korrespondent Johannes Perterer mit Wissenschaftlerinnen, die NGT - also die "Neue Gentechnik" - als groSSe Chance sehen: mit Entwicklungen wie der sogenannten "Genschere" sind prazisere Eingriffe ins Erbgut moglich, wodurch Pflanzen kunftig widerstandsfahiger gegen Klimaextreme und Schadlinge werden und ihr Anbau die Boden weniger belastet. Fur einige junge Bauern steht fest: in Zukunft muss Landwirtschaft nicht im Widerspruch zur Natur stehen. Nach einigen Durresommern wurden sie resistenteren NGT-Mais einsetzen. Doch es bleibt die Sorge, dass neben der Abhangigkeit von Saatgutkonzernen NGT-Saatgut am Ende des Tages fur kleine Bauern zu teuer sein wird.USA-Korrespondent Thomas Langpaul ist auf Lokalaugenschein in Oklahoma unterwegs. Der Bundesstaat im zentralen Suden des Landes zahlt zu den fuhrenden Weizenproduzenten und ist einer der Hotspots der amerikanischen Agrarindustrie. Auf den riesigen Farmen, die nach wie vor auf die klassische Gentechnik (GMO) setzen, wird neben Weizen vor allem Mais, Soja und Baumwolle angebaut. Doch auch hier beginnt ein Umdenken, denn die Folgen des Klimawandels - wie extreme Durreperioden, Bodenerosion und damit sinkende Ertrage - stellen auch die GroSSbetriebe vor enorme Herausforderungen.In Sri Lanka wagt die Regierung 2021 ein Experiment: das gesamte Land soll auf biologische Landwirtschaft umgestellt werden. Anstatt eines schrittweisen Überganges werden Einfuhr und Verwendung synthetischer Dungemittel und Pestizide quasi uber Nacht verboten. Binnen weniger Monate brechen die Ernteertrage drastisch ein, die Lebensmittelpreise schieSSen in die Hohe, Proteste erschuttern das Land. Korrespondent Benedict Feichtner trifft Bauernfamilien, die als Folge des abrupten Umstiegs ihre Existenzgrundlage verloren haben. Inzwischen sind importiertes Saatgut und chemische Spritzmittel wieder zugelassen, doch gleichzeitig ist eine Art Gegenbewegung entstanden: in Schulungszentren lernen Kleinbauern heute, wie sie mit traditionellen und regenerativen Methoden Bio-Landwirtschaft nachhaltig betreiben und so aus der Abhangigkeit von den groSSen Saatgut-Konzernen entkommen konnen.

programme.title: Tiroler Bauernhauser - Zwischen Romantik und Realitat
programme.desc: "As soon as the flies revolve around the soup, the romanticism at the farm catches up," says Tyrolean farmer and actor Tobias Moretti. With his wife Julia, he manages an old farm near Innsbruck. "We voluntarily bought hard work," says the passionate farmer Julia Moretti. 30 years ago, 700 powdery ensembles were preserved in Tyrol, today there are just 80. For this riveting result there is a study carried out by the Tyrolean art cadastre. Julia Moretti is committed to the "Langenfeld explanation" as an ambassador for the "Landliche Baukultur. But what does an active farmer do with an old farm who is a listed building and who is difficult to manage with a modern tractor? Teresa Andreae, the designer of the documentary, visited several historical farmers' farm in North and East Tyrol with her team and shows in Austria, picture "Tiroler Bauernhauser - between romanticism and reality" which different forms of continued life are possible. / "Sobald die Fliegen aus dem Stall um die Suppe kreisen, hort sich die Romantik am Bauernhof auf", sagt der Tiroler Bauer und Schauspieler Tobias Moretti. Er bewirtschaftet mit seiner Frau Julia einen alten Hof in der Nahe von Innsbruck. "Wir haben uns freiwillig harte Arbeit gekauft", sagt die leidenschaftliche Bauerin Julia Moretti. Vor 30 Jahren waren in Tirol noch 700 bauerliche Ensembles erhalten, heute sind es gerade noch 80. Zu diesem aufruttelnden Ergebnis kommt eine vom Tiroler Kunstkataster durchgefuhrte Studie. Julia Moretti engagiert sich als Botschafterin fur die "Langenfelder Erklarung", das ist ein Pladoyer fur den Erhalt von landlicher Baukultur. Doch was tut ein aktiver Bauer mit einem alten Hof, der unter Denkmalschutz steht, und der sich mit einem modernen Traktor nur schwer bewirtschaften lasst? Teresa Andreae, die Gestalterin der Dokumentation, hat mit ihrem Team mehrere historische Bauernhofe in Nord- und Osttirol besucht und zeigt im Österreich Bild am Feiertag "Tiroler Bauernhauser - Zwischen Romantik und Realitat" welche unterschiedlichen Formen des Weiterlebens moglich sind.

programme.title: Traumschlosser und Ritterburgen
programme.desc: From Strudengau to the upper Muhlviertel - the castles and locksmith in the Oberosterreiche Danube region are preserved by their owners with foresight for the coming generations.1822 the Saxony -Coburg and Gotha Schloss Greinburg have acquired in Grein an der Donau. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg and Gotha visits the oldest residential castle in Austria several times a month. Further west is the alleged oldest city in Austria: Enns. Parts of the Castle Ennsegg. Just a few kilometers from the state capital Linz, the castle of the same name is located in the municipality of Steygg, on which Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt has headed the forest and estate administration since 2009. Starhemberg Castle has been owned by the Starhemberg family in Eferding west of Linz for around 450 years. Today it houses the family museum and the museum of the city of Eferding, and it is the residence of today's owner Georg Adam Starhemberg. Altenhof Castle in the Upper Muhlviertel once hired as well as the Falkenstein Castle in the immediate vicinity to rule the powerful Falkensteiner. Schloss Altenhof and the Ruin Falkenstein have been owned by the Counts Salburg-Falkenstein for over 400 years. / Vom Strudengau bis ins Obere Muhlviertel - die Burgen und Schlosser in der oberosterreichischen Donauregion werden von ihren Besitzerinnen und Besitzern mit Weitblick fur die kommenden Generationen bewahrt.1822 hat die Familie Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha Schloss Greinburg in Grein an der Donau erworben. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha besucht das alteste Wohnschloss Österreichs mehrmals im Monat. Weiter westlich befindet sich die vorgeblich alteste Stadt Österreichs: Enns. Als Teil der Stadtbefestigung dienten einst Teile der Anlage von Schloss Ennsegg. Nur wenige Kilometer von der Landeshauptstadt Linz entfernt befindet sich in der Stadtgemeinde Steyregg das gleichnamige Schloss, auf dem Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt seit 2009 die Forst- und Gutsverwaltung leitet. Seit rund 450 Jahren ist Schloss Starhemberg in Eferding westlich von Linz im Besitz der furstlichen Familie Starhemberg. Heute beherbergt es das Familienmuseum, sowie das Museum der Stadt Eferding, und es ist der Wohnsitz des heutigen Besitzers Georg Adam Starhemberg. Schloss Altenhof im Oberen Muhlviertel gehorte einst wie auch die in der unmittelbaren Umgebung gelegene Burg Falkenstein zur Herrschaft der machtigen Falkensteiner. Seit uber 400 Jahren sind Schloss Altenhof und die Ruine Falkenstein im Besitz der Grafen Salburg-Falkenstein.

programme.title: Seiji Ozawa - back in Japan / Seiji Ozawa - Zuruck in Japan
programme.desc: Born in 1935, Seiji Ozawa was an outstanding artist's personality until his death in February 2024 that never met the cliché of a "classic" musician. Ozawa learned from Leonard Bernstein and Herbert von Karajan and was the first Asian to head a large western orchestra: the renowned Boston Symphony Orchestra, at the top of which he was supposed to stand for almost 30 years. The Japanese conductor made the orchestra from Boston one of the most found ensembles of North America. After a serious illness, Seiji Ozawa, who was music director of the Vienna State Opera from 2002 to 2010, finally finally returned to Japan. There he was primarily concerned with the demand for young musicians, whom he wanted to convey his love for music. Director Olivier Simonnet accompanied Ozawa in Japan for almost two years. In the portrait, Seiji Ozawa speaks about Asia, the discovery of the western repertoire in Japan, large composers and of course about the transfer of his can. His split relationship to his home country also becomes clear: the musician, who was celebrated as a national hero, was earlier an outsider who tackled his claims and his love of freedom. / 1935 geboren, war Seiji Ozawa bis zu seinem Tod im Februar 2024 eine herausragende Kunstlerpersonlichkeit, die nie dem Klischee eines "klassischen" Musikers entsprach. Ozawa lernte bei Leonard Bernstein und Herbert von Karajan und leitete als erster Asiate ein groSSes westliches Orchester: das renommierte Boston Symphony Orchestra, an dessen Spitze er nahezu 30 Jahre lang stehen sollte. Der japanische Dirigent machte das Orchester aus Boston zu einem der beruhmtesten Ensembles Nordamerikas.Nach einer schweren Erkrankung kehrte Seiji Ozawa, der von 2002 bis 2010 Musikdirektor der Wiener Staatsoper war, schlieSSlich endgultig nach Japan zuruck. Dort bemuhte er sich vor allem um die Forderung von jungen Nachwuchsmusikern, denen er seine Liebe zur Musik vermitteln wollte.Regisseur Olivier Simonnet begleitete Ozawa fast zwei Jahre lang in Japan. In dem Portrait spricht Seiji Ozawa uber Asien, die Entdeckung des westlichen Repertoires in Japan, groSSe Komponisten und naturlich uber die Weitergabe seines Konnens. Dabei wird auch sein gespaltenes Verhaltnis zu seinem Heimatland deutlich: Der Musiker, der als Nationalheld gefeiert wurde, war fruher ein Outsider, der mit seinen Anspruchen und seiner Freiheitsliebe aneckte.

programme.title: Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers
programme.sub-title: From the Puszta to the Adriatic / Von der Puszta an die Adria
programme.desc: The five of the successful series "On the rails of the double -headed eagle" by Bjorn Kolz and Gernot Stadler takes the viewer on a cinematic journey into the Hungarian imperial monster of the former Danube monarchy.*The Hungarian lanes with their train station, bridges and viaducts are both architecturally and cultural -historically. They achieved their importance as a connection between the Eastern and Western European economic areas with the Balkans.*Once there was a country, from whose sky sun, crescent moon and Davidstern, a realm, as far as the flight of the Habsburg dual eagle. What remained have remained memories of a time that has been forgiven for their mistakes and which is called the "good old". And they are rail streets that have remained. Iron Bander, laid on thousands of kilometers between swamps and gorges, steppe and sea. They once kept together an empire in the heart of Europe: Austria-Hungary. The starting point of the cinematic journey is Budapest with its elaborated Bahnhofen, the Keleti and the Nyugati train station, two magnificent cathedrals of the railway age. Georg Habsburg runs through Budapest, where his grandfather Karl was crowned for the last king of Hungary and accompanies us to Godollo, the favorite castle of Konigin Elisabeth. A visit to the largest railway museum in Europe, the Budapest locomotive park, as little as a ride with a historic steam train on the oldest railway line in Hungary. The same as the railway network in the Hungarian empire wasted from Budapest from a star form, and also follows the old train lines according to Temesvar in today's Rumania, to "Banmering" With its numerous browns and tunnels, to the forest railways in Sudwesten in Hungary or to Croatia, where the so -called "Hungarian Riviera" attracted numerous nobles, artists and burger year for year. The port city of Fiume, today's Rijeka, competed with the Easter Reiche harbor and still testify to many buildings in the old town or the old shipyards from the former glory of Rijeka at the time of the Habsburg. "On the rails of the double eagle - from the Puszta to the Adriatic" is a cinematic journey through the times and to be removed from the former. Austria-Hungary, which was held together not least by his more than 46,000 kilometer railway network until his demise. / Der funfte Teil der Erfolgsserie "Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers" von Bjorn Kolz und Gernot Stadler nimmt den Zuseher mit auf eine filmische Reise in die ungarische Reichshalfte der ehemaligen Donaumonarchie.*Die ungarischen Bahnen mit ihren Bahnhofen, Brucken und Viadukten gelten sowohl architektonisch als auch kulturgeschichtlich als Leistung ersten Ranges. Ihre Bedeutung erlangten sie als Verbindung zwischen den ost- und westeuropaischen Wirtschaftsraumen mit dem Balkan.*Es war einmal ein Land, von dessen Himmel Sonne, Halbmond und Davidstern friedlich vereint herabfunkelten, ein Reich, so weit wie die Flugelspannen des habsburgischen Doppeladlers. Geblieben sind Erinnerungen an eine Zeit, der man ihre Fehler langst verziehen hat und die man die "gute alte" nennt. Und es sind Schienenstrange, die geblieben sind. Eiserne Bander, verlegt auf tausenden Kilometern zwischen Sumpfen und Schluchten, Steppe und Meer. Einst hielten sie ein Reich im Herzen Europas zusammen: Österreich-Ungarn.Ausgangspunkt der filmischen Reise ist Budapest mit seinen beruhmten Bahnhofen, dem Keleti und dem Nyugati-Bahnhof, zwei prachtvollen Kathedralen des Eisenbahnzeitalters. Georg Habsburg fuhrt durch Budapest, wo sein GroSSvater Karl zum letzten Konig von Ungarn gekront wurde und begleitet uns nach Godollo, dem Lieblingsschloss von Konigin Elisabeth. Ein Besuch im groSSten Eisenbahnmuseum Europas, dem Lokpark von Budapest fehlt ebenso wenig, wie eine Fahrt mit einem historischen Dampfzug auf der altesten Bahnlinie Ungarns.So wie sich das Eisenbahnnetz in der ungarischen Reichshalfte von Budapest aus sternformig verzweigte und in alle Himmelrichtungen fuhrte, folgt auch die Dokumentation den alten Bahnlinien nach Temesvar im heutigen Rumanien, zum "Banater Semmering" mit seinen zahlreichen Brucken und Tunnels, zu den Waldbahnen im Sudwesten Ungarns oder nach Kroatien, wo die sogenannte "ungarische Riviera" Jahr fur Jahr zahlreiche Adelige, Kunstler und Burger anlockte. Die Hafenstadt Fiume, das heutige Rijeka, machte dem osterreichischen Hafen Triest Konkurrenz und auch jetzt noch zeugen viele Gebaude in der Altstadt oder die alten Werftanlagen vom einstigen Glanz Rijekas zur Zeit der Habsburger."Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers - Von der Puszta an die Adria" ist eine filmische Reise durch die Zeiten und zu entlegenen Winkeln des einstigen Vielvolkerstaates Österreich-Ungarn, der bis zu seinem Untergang nicht zuletzt von seinem mehr als 46.000 Kilometer langen Eisenbahnnetz zusammengehalten wurde.Eine Dokumentation von Gernot Stadler und Bjorn Kolz

programme.title: Traumschlosser und Ritterburgen
programme.desc: From Strudengau to the upper Muhlviertel - the castles and locksmith in the Oberosterreiche Danube region are preserved by their owners with foresight for the coming generations.1822 the Saxony -Coburg and Gotha Schloss Greinburg have acquired in Grein an der Donau. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg and Gotha visits the oldest residential castle in Austria several times a month. Further west is the alleged oldest city in Austria: Enns. Parts of the Castle Ennsegg. Just a few kilometers from the state capital Linz, the castle of the same name is located in the municipality of Steygg, on which Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt has headed the forest and estate administration since 2009. Starhemberg Castle has been owned by the Starhemberg family in Eferding west of Linz for around 450 years. Today it houses the family museum and the museum of the city of Eferding, and it is the residence of today's owner Georg Adam Starhemberg. Altenhof Castle in the Upper Muhlviertel once hired as well as the Falkenstein Castle in the immediate vicinity to rule the powerful Falkensteiner. Schloss Altenhof and the Ruin Falkenstein have been owned by the Counts Salburg-Falkenstein for over 400 years. / Vom Strudengau bis ins Obere Muhlviertel - die Burgen und Schlosser in der oberosterreichischen Donauregion werden von ihren Besitzerinnen und Besitzern mit Weitblick fur die kommenden Generationen bewahrt.1822 hat die Familie Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha Schloss Greinburg in Grein an der Donau erworben. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha besucht das alteste Wohnschloss Österreichs mehrmals im Monat. Weiter westlich befindet sich die vorgeblich alteste Stadt Österreichs: Enns. Als Teil der Stadtbefestigung dienten einst Teile der Anlage von Schloss Ennsegg. Nur wenige Kilometer von der Landeshauptstadt Linz entfernt befindet sich in der Stadtgemeinde Steyregg das gleichnamige Schloss, auf dem Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt seit 2009 die Forst- und Gutsverwaltung leitet. Seit rund 450 Jahren ist Schloss Starhemberg in Eferding westlich von Linz im Besitz der furstlichen Familie Starhemberg. Heute beherbergt es das Familienmuseum, sowie das Museum der Stadt Eferding, und es ist der Wohnsitz des heutigen Besitzers Georg Adam Starhemberg. Schloss Altenhof im Oberen Muhlviertel gehorte einst wie auch die in der unmittelbaren Umgebung gelegene Burg Falkenstein zur Herrschaft der machtigen Falkensteiner. Seit uber 400 Jahren sind Schloss Altenhof und die Ruine Falkenstein im Besitz der Grafen Salburg-Falkenstein.

programme.title: Seiji Ozawa - back in Japan / Seiji Ozawa - Zuruck in Japan
programme.desc: Born in 1935, Seiji Ozawa was an outstanding artist's personality until his death in February 2024 that never met the cliché of a "classic" musician. Ozawa learned from Leonard Bernstein and Herbert von Karajan and was the first Asian to head a large western orchestra: the renowned Boston Symphony Orchestra, at the top of which he was supposed to stand for almost 30 years. The Japanese conductor made the orchestra from Boston one of the most found ensembles of North America. After a serious illness, Seiji Ozawa, who was music director of the Vienna State Opera from 2002 to 2010, finally finally returned to Japan. There he was primarily concerned with the demand for young musicians, whom he wanted to convey his love for music. Director Olivier Simonnet accompanied Ozawa in Japan for almost two years. In the portrait, Seiji Ozawa speaks about Asia, the discovery of the western repertoire in Japan, large composers and of course about the transfer of his can. His split relationship to his home country also becomes clear: the musician, who was celebrated as a national hero, was earlier an outsider who tackled his claims and his love of freedom. / 1935 geboren, war Seiji Ozawa bis zu seinem Tod im Februar 2024 eine herausragende Kunstlerpersonlichkeit, die nie dem Klischee eines "klassischen" Musikers entsprach. Ozawa lernte bei Leonard Bernstein und Herbert von Karajan und leitete als erster Asiate ein groSSes westliches Orchester: das renommierte Boston Symphony Orchestra, an dessen Spitze er nahezu 30 Jahre lang stehen sollte. Der japanische Dirigent machte das Orchester aus Boston zu einem der beruhmtesten Ensembles Nordamerikas.Nach einer schweren Erkrankung kehrte Seiji Ozawa, der von 2002 bis 2010 Musikdirektor der Wiener Staatsoper war, schlieSSlich endgultig nach Japan zuruck. Dort bemuhte er sich vor allem um die Forderung von jungen Nachwuchsmusikern, denen er seine Liebe zur Musik vermitteln wollte.Regisseur Olivier Simonnet begleitete Ozawa fast zwei Jahre lang in Japan. In dem Portrait spricht Seiji Ozawa uber Asien, die Entdeckung des westlichen Repertoires in Japan, groSSe Komponisten und naturlich uber die Weitergabe seines Konnens. Dabei wird auch sein gespaltenes Verhaltnis zu seinem Heimatland deutlich: Der Musiker, der als Nationalheld gefeiert wurde, war fruher ein Outsider, der mit seinen Anspruchen und seiner Freiheitsliebe aneckte.

programme.title: WeltWeit
programme.sub-title: Agriculture in change. Does the future of genetic engineering belong? / Landwirtschaft im Wandel. Gehort die Zukunft der Gentechnik?
programme.desc: The use of genetic engineering in agriculture is still controversial after almost 30 years. In addition to environmental concerns and the monopoly position of some fewer seed manufacturers, critics drove the long-term consequences to be tapped. In Europe, many consumers vehemently reject "genetic engineering on the plate". The cultivation of genetically connected plants has been cut in the EU, and in Austria they still have not come to the fields. The large agricultural -producing countries such as the USA, Canada, Brazil or India, on the other hand, rely flatly on it: worldwide generous plants are grown on around 200 million hectares of hectares. Minged into the genome, which means that plants become more resistant to climate extremes and males more resistance and their cultivation is less stressful. For some young farmers it is clear: in the future, agriculture does not have to contradict nature. After a few Durresommern, they were used more resistant NGT corn. But there is worry that in addition to the dependency on seed companies NGT seeds at the end of the day will be too expensive for small farmers. USA correspondent Thomas Langpaul is on local inspection in Oklahoma. The state in the country's central Suden pays to the fuided wheat producers and is one of the hotspots of the American agricultural industry. In addition to wheat, corn, soy and cotton is grown on the huge farms that still rely on classic genetic engineering (GMO). But here too, a rethink begins, because the consequences of climate change - such as extreme dur periods, soil erosion and thus falling streak - also present the large companies with enormous challenges. In 2021, the government dares an experiment: the entire country is to be switched to biological agriculture. Instead of a gradual transition, import and use of synthetic dung agents and pesticides are banned almost over night. Within a few months, the harvesting carrier breaks down drastically, the food prices shoot into the high, protests shocks the country. Correspondent Benedict Feichtner meets peasant families who have lost their livelihood as a result of the abrupt change. In the meantime, imported seeds and chemical sprays have been approved again, but at the same time a kind of countermovement has arisen: in training centers, small farmers learn today how they can sustainably operate organic farming using traditional and regenerative methods and thus escape the dependency on the large seed corporations. / Der Einsatz von Gentechnik in der Landwirtschaft ist - nach inzwischen fast 30 Jahren - immer noch umstritten. Kritiker fuhren neben Umweltbedenken und der Monopolstellung einiger weniger Saatgut-Hersteller vor allem die schwer abzuschatzenden Langzeitfolgen ins Treffen. In Europa lehnen viele Verbraucher "Gentechnik am Teller" vehement ab. Der Anbau gentechnisch veranderter Pflanzen ist in der EU stark eingeschrankt, in Österreich kommen sie bis heute nicht auf die Felder. Die groSSen agrarproduzierenden Lander wie die USA, Kanada, Brasilien oder auch Indien setzen hingegen flachendeckend darauf: weltweit werden auf rund 200 Millionen Hektar genmodifizierte Pflanzen angebaut.In Belgien spricht Korrespondent Johannes Perterer mit Wissenschaftlerinnen, die NGT - also die "Neue Gentechnik" - als groSSe Chance sehen: mit Entwicklungen wie der sogenannten "Genschere" sind prazisere Eingriffe ins Erbgut moglich, wodurch Pflanzen kunftig widerstandsfahiger gegen Klimaextreme und Schadlinge werden und ihr Anbau die Boden weniger belastet. Fur einige junge Bauern steht fest: in Zukunft muss Landwirtschaft nicht im Widerspruch zur Natur stehen. Nach einigen Durresommern wurden sie resistenteren NGT-Mais einsetzen. Doch es bleibt die Sorge, dass neben der Abhangigkeit von Saatgutkonzernen NGT-Saatgut am Ende des Tages fur kleine Bauern zu teuer sein wird.USA-Korrespondent Thomas Langpaul ist auf Lokalaugenschein in Oklahoma unterwegs. Der Bundesstaat im zentralen Suden des Landes zahlt zu den fuhrenden Weizenproduzenten und ist einer der Hotspots der amerikanischen Agrarindustrie. Auf den riesigen Farmen, die nach wie vor auf die klassische Gentechnik (GMO) setzen, wird neben Weizen vor allem Mais, Soja und Baumwolle angebaut. Doch auch hier beginnt ein Umdenken, denn die Folgen des Klimawandels - wie extreme Durreperioden, Bodenerosion und damit sinkende Ertrage - stellen auch die GroSSbetriebe vor enorme Herausforderungen.In Sri Lanka wagt die Regierung 2021 ein Experiment: das gesamte Land soll auf biologische Landwirtschaft umgestellt werden. Anstatt eines schrittweisen Überganges werden Einfuhr und Verwendung synthetischer Dungemittel und Pestizide quasi uber Nacht verboten. Binnen weniger Monate brechen die Ernteertrage drastisch ein, die Lebensmittelpreise schieSSen in die Hohe, Proteste erschuttern das Land. Korrespondent Benedict Feichtner trifft Bauernfamilien, die als Folge des abrupten Umstiegs ihre Existenzgrundlage verloren haben. Inzwischen sind importiertes Saatgut und chemische Spritzmittel wieder zugelassen, doch gleichzeitig ist eine Art Gegenbewegung entstanden: in Schulungszentren lernen Kleinbauern heute, wie sie mit traditionellen und regenerativen Methoden Bio-Landwirtschaft nachhaltig betreiben und so aus der Abhangigkeit von den groSSen Saatgut-Konzernen entkommen konnen.

programme.title: Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers
programme.sub-title: From the Puszta to the Adriatic / Von der Puszta an die Adria
programme.desc: The five of the successful series "On the rails of the double -headed eagle" by Bjorn Kolz and Gernot Stadler takes the viewer on a cinematic journey into the Hungarian imperial monster of the former Danube monarchy.*The Hungarian lanes with their train station, bridges and viaducts are both architecturally and cultural -historically. They achieved their importance as a connection between the Eastern and Western European economic areas with the Balkans.*Once there was a country, from whose sky sun, crescent moon and Davidstern, a realm, as far as the flight of the Habsburg dual eagle. What remained have remained memories of a time that has been forgiven for their mistakes and which is called the "good old". And they are rail streets that have remained. Iron Bander, laid on thousands of kilometers between swamps and gorges, steppe and sea. They once kept together an empire in the heart of Europe: Austria-Hungary. The starting point of the cinematic journey is Budapest with its elaborated Bahnhofen, the Keleti and the Nyugati train station, two magnificent cathedrals of the railway age. Georg Habsburg runs through Budapest, where his grandfather Karl was crowned for the last king of Hungary and accompanies us to Godollo, the favorite castle of Konigin Elisabeth. A visit to the largest railway museum in Europe, the Budapest locomotive park, as little as a ride with a historic steam train on the oldest railway line in Hungary. The same as the railway network in the Hungarian empire wasted from Budapest from a star form, and also follows the old train lines according to Temesvar in today's Rumania, to "Banmering" With its numerous browns and tunnels, to the forest railways in Sudwesten in Hungary or to Croatia, where the so -called "Hungarian Riviera" attracted numerous nobles, artists and burger year for year. The port city of Fiume, today's Rijeka, competed with the Easter Reiche harbor and still testify to many buildings in the old town or the old shipyards from the former glory of Rijeka at the time of the Habsburg. "On the rails of the double eagle - from the Puszta to the Adriatic" is a cinematic journey through the times and to be removed from the former. Austria-Hungary, which was held together not least by his more than 46,000 kilometer railway network until his demise. / Der funfte Teil der Erfolgsserie "Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers" von Bjorn Kolz und Gernot Stadler nimmt den Zuseher mit auf eine filmische Reise in die ungarische Reichshalfte der ehemaligen Donaumonarchie.*Die ungarischen Bahnen mit ihren Bahnhofen, Brucken und Viadukten gelten sowohl architektonisch als auch kulturgeschichtlich als Leistung ersten Ranges. Ihre Bedeutung erlangten sie als Verbindung zwischen den ost- und westeuropaischen Wirtschaftsraumen mit dem Balkan.*Es war einmal ein Land, von dessen Himmel Sonne, Halbmond und Davidstern friedlich vereint herabfunkelten, ein Reich, so weit wie die Flugelspannen des habsburgischen Doppeladlers. Geblieben sind Erinnerungen an eine Zeit, der man ihre Fehler langst verziehen hat und die man die "gute alte" nennt. Und es sind Schienenstrange, die geblieben sind. Eiserne Bander, verlegt auf tausenden Kilometern zwischen Sumpfen und Schluchten, Steppe und Meer. Einst hielten sie ein Reich im Herzen Europas zusammen: Österreich-Ungarn.Ausgangspunkt der filmischen Reise ist Budapest mit seinen beruhmten Bahnhofen, dem Keleti und dem Nyugati-Bahnhof, zwei prachtvollen Kathedralen des Eisenbahnzeitalters. Georg Habsburg fuhrt durch Budapest, wo sein GroSSvater Karl zum letzten Konig von Ungarn gekront wurde und begleitet uns nach Godollo, dem Lieblingsschloss von Konigin Elisabeth. Ein Besuch im groSSten Eisenbahnmuseum Europas, dem Lokpark von Budapest fehlt ebenso wenig, wie eine Fahrt mit einem historischen Dampfzug auf der altesten Bahnlinie Ungarns.So wie sich das Eisenbahnnetz in der ungarischen Reichshalfte von Budapest aus sternformig verzweigte und in alle Himmelrichtungen fuhrte, folgt auch die Dokumentation den alten Bahnlinien nach Temesvar im heutigen Rumanien, zum "Banater Semmering" mit seinen zahlreichen Brucken und Tunnels, zu den Waldbahnen im Sudwesten Ungarns oder nach Kroatien, wo die sogenannte "ungarische Riviera" Jahr fur Jahr zahlreiche Adelige, Kunstler und Burger anlockte. Die Hafenstadt Fiume, das heutige Rijeka, machte dem osterreichischen Hafen Triest Konkurrenz und auch jetzt noch zeugen viele Gebaude in der Altstadt oder die alten Werftanlagen vom einstigen Glanz Rijekas zur Zeit der Habsburger."Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers - Von der Puszta an die Adria" ist eine filmische Reise durch die Zeiten und zu entlegenen Winkeln des einstigen Vielvolkerstaates Österreich-Ungarn, der bis zu seinem Untergang nicht zuletzt von seinem mehr als 46.000 Kilometer langen Eisenbahnnetz zusammengehalten wurde.Eine Dokumentation von Gernot Stadler und Bjorn Kolz
