programme.title: Red October hunt: The true story E1 (e) / Το Κυνήγι του Κόκκινου Οκτώβρη: η Αληθινή Ιστορία Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: The documentary reveals for the first time the incredible events behind the disappearance of the Soviet Nuclear submarine K-129 that disappeared on March 8, 1968, bringing the Soviet Union and the US to the brink of war. / Το ντοκιμαντέρ αποκαλύπτει για πρώτη φορά τα απίστευτα γεγονότα πίσω από την εξαφάνιση του σοβιετικού πυρηνικού υποβρυχίου Κ-129 που εξαφανίστηκε στις 8 Μαρτίου 1968, φέρνοντας τη Σοβιετική Ένωση και τις ΗΠΑ στα πρόθυρα του πολέμου.

programme.title: Brazilero / Μπραζιλέρο
programme.desc: A local factor of a provincial city, which has received European funding for 10 years ago to build a cultural center, receives a sudden visit of two financial auditors ... and the euphoric begins. (92) / Ένας τοπικός παράγοντας μιας επαρχιακής πόλης, ο οποίος πριν από 10 έτη έλαβε ευρωπαϊκή χρηματοδότηση για την ανέγερση ενός πολιτιστικού κέντρου, δέχεται την ξαφνική επίσκεψη δυο οικονομικών ελεγκτών... και τα ευτράπελα ξεκινούν. (92)

programme.title: Hawking
programme.desc: At the end of January 1963, 21 -year -old Stephen Hawking stood in front of the Director of Neurology at London's St Bartholomews Hospital, who told him that he had only 2 years of life ... The diagnosis proved to be a mistake. (90) / Στα τέλη Ιανουαρίου του 1963, ο 21 ετών Stephen Hawking στάθηκε μπροστά στο διευθυντή νευρολογίας του νοσοκομείου St Bartholomews του Λονδίνου, ο οποίος του δήλωσε ότι έχει μόνο άλλα 2 χρόνια ζωής... Η διάγνωση αποδείχτηκε λάθος. (90)

The show focuses on players who are competing for the applause and honor of the village and jersey. / Επεισόδιο: ΑΟ Συκιάς Ημαθίας. Τρία σημεία ορίζουν τη ζωή και τις αξίες της ελληνικής υπαίθρου. Η εκκλησία, το καφενείο και το ποδοσφαιρικό γήπεδο. Η εκπομπή εστιάζει στους ποδοσφαιριστές που αγωνίζονται για το χειροκρότημα και την τιμή του χωριού και της φανέλας.

programme.title: Perimeter (e) / Περίμετρος (Ε)
programme.desc: An informative broadcast that focuses daily on the news and on specific issues, in concentric circles, with a focus on Thessaloniki, the regions of the country, our neighboring countries and the community. / Ενημερωτική εκπομπή η οποία επικεντρώνει καθημερινά στην επικαιρότητα και σε ειδικά θέματα, σε ομόκεντρους κύκλους, με έμφαση τη Θεσσαλονίκη, τις περιφέρειες της χώρας, τις γειτονικές μας χώρες και την Ομογένεια.

programme.title: It's up to you K2 E4 (e) / Είναι στο Χέρι σου Κ2 Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Ilenia and Stefanos show us step by step the process to build a bedside table, which fits every living room and reveal all the secrets to keep our garden lawn healthy and lush. / Η Ιλένια και ο Στέφανος μας δείχνουν βήμα-βήμα τη διαδικασία για να κατασκευάσουμε ένα κομοδίνο-ραφάκι, που ταιριάζει σε κάθε καθιστικό και αποκαλύπτουν όλα τα μυστικά για να κρατήσουμε υγιές και καταπράσινο το γκαζόν του κήπου μας.

programme.title: Celebrating Bach in Leipzig (e) / Γιορτάζοντας τον Μπαχ στη Λειψία (Ε)
programme.desc: In 2023 international music stars were gathered in Leipzig for the 300th anniversary of Bach's definition as a Canor in Thomaskirche - a position he held for a period of 25 years during which he created his most important works. / Το 2023 διεθνείς αστέρες της μουσικής μαζεύτηκαν στη Λειψία για την 300ή επέτειο από τον ορισμό του Μπαχ ως Κάντορα στην Thomaskirche - θέση που κατείχε για μία περίοδο 25 ετών κατά την οποία δημιούργησε τα σπουδαιότερα έργα του.

programme.desc: We are out in the dark night bathed in the light that scatters the North Lights. The impressive images are accompanied by the Norwegian radio orchestra with specially selected classic works. / Βρισκόμαστε έξω στη σκοτεινή νύχτα λουσμένοι στο φως που σκορπίζει το βόρειο σέλας. Τις εντυπωσιακές εικόνες συνοδεύει η Νορβηγική Ραδιοφωνική Ορχήστρα με ειδικά επιλεγμένα κλασικά έργα.

programme.title: Lake Ballaton - Europe's hidden paradise (e) / Λίμνη Μπάλατον - Ο Κρυμμένος Παράδεισος Της Ευρώπης (Ε)
programme.desc: Welcome to the hidden paradise of Lake Balaton, the largest freshwater area in Central Europe. It was formed at the time of glaciers by tectonic forces and nature affects the lake to this day. / Καλώς ήρθατε στον κρυμμένο παράδεισο της Λίμνης Μπάλατον, της μεγαλύτερης περιοχής γλυκού νερού στην Κεντρική Ευρώπη. Διαμορφώθηκε κατά την Εποχή των Παγετώνων από τεκτονικές δυνάμεις και η φύση επηρεάζει τη λίμνη μέχρι και σήμερα.

programme.title: United by Emotion: Covid Olympics (E) / United By Emotion: Οι Ολυμπιακοί του Covid (Ε)
programme.desc: The Tokyo Olympics in 2021 took place while the whole planet was in Lockdown and Japan opened its borders only for the 200 countries' missions that participated in the event - including the Greek mission. / Οι Ολυμπιακοί Αγώνες του Τόκιο το 2021 έγιναν ενώ όλος ο πλανήτης ήταν σε lockdown και η Ιαπωνία άνοιξε τα σύνορά της μόνο για τις αποστολές των 200 χωρών που συμμετείχαν στη διοργάνωση - ανάμεσά τους και η αποστολή της Ελλάδας.

Επιλέγουν τον δύσκολο δρόμο της θεραπείας και της δημιουργίας.

programme.title: Sunday in the village again (e) / Κυριακή στο Χωριό Ξανά (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Arta Arta. Brand new idea on traditional show. The village remains the protagonist, the people who inhabit it, their lives, the way they reproduce their traditions, everything they have achieved in time and everything they dream of. / Επεισόδιο: Καστανιά Άρτας. Ολοκαίνουργια ιδέα πάνω στην παραδοσιακή εκπομπή. Πρωταγωνιστής παραμένει το χωριό, οι άνθρωποι που το κατοικούν, οι ζωές τους, ο τρόπος που αναπαράγουν τις παραδόσεις τους, όλα όσα έχουν πετύχει μέσα στο χρόνο κι όλα όσα ονειρεύονται.

programme.title: From the field to the shelf K2 E2 (E) / Από το Χωράφι στο Ράφι Κ2 Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Lee. Lead is originally from the Middle East, in Europe thanks to the ancient Romans, while in Greece it has been cultivated since antiquity. A research on delicious vegetable, which we will find in many cooking recipes. / Επεισόδιο: Πράσο. Το πράσο έχει καταγωγή από τη Μέση Ανατολή, στην Ευρώπη πέρασε χάρη στους αρχαίους Ρωμαίους, ενώ στην Ελλάδα καλλιεργείται από την αρχαιότητα. Μία έρευνα για το νόστιμο λαχανικό, που θα το συναντήσουμε σε πολλές συνταγές μαγειρικής.

programme.title: The Aegean of our life E2 / Το Αιγαίο της Ζωής μας Ε2
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Offer offers. ERT3 records the course and work of the Aegean Group 130 volunteers, crossing the waves to provide meaningful care and hope to residents of the islands through medical, informative, construction, educational and cultural activities. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Προσφορά στα Άκρα. Η ΕΡΤ3 καταγράφει την πορεία και το έργο των 130 εθελοντών της Ομάδας Αιγαίου, που διασχίζουν τα κύματα για να δώσουν ουσιαστική φροντίδα και ελπίδα στους κατοίκους των ακριτικών νησιών μέσα από ιατρικές, ενημερωτικές, κατασκευαστικές, εκπαιδευτικές και πολιτιστικές δράσεις.

programme.title: Greek events K8 E11 (E) / Ελλήνων Δρώμενα Κ8 Ε11 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Zeibekik. The show is researching, seeking and detecting the course of creating, developing and shaping the Zeibekian dance, which has been identified with tradition and has starred in the formation of our popular culture. / Επεισόδιο: Ζεϊμπέκικος. Η εκπομπή ερευνά, αναζητά και ανιχνεύει την πορεία δημιουργίας, ανάπτυξης και διαμόρφωσης του ζεϊμπέκικου χορού, που έχει ταυτιστεί με την παράδοση και έχει πρωταγωνιστήσει στη διαμόρφωση του λαϊκού μας πολιτισμού.

programme.title: Musikology E7 (E) / Musikology Ε7 (Ε)
programme.desc: We find out whether or not music helps to concentrate, we are discussing the (serious) possibility that Jim Morrison will live and present the evolution of music in video games. / Ανακαλύπτουμε αν η μουσική βοηθάει ή όχι στη συγκέντρωση, συζητάμε το (σοβαρό) ενδεχόμενο ο Τζιμ Μόρρισον να ζει και παρουσιάζουμε την εξέλιξη της μουσικής στα video games.

programme.title: The last giraffe (e) / Η Τελευταία Καμηλοπάρδαλη (Ε)
programme.desc: We will tell you the survival story of the latest giraffes, the savannah queens. Let's go back to the end of 2016, when we learned that the giraffe is threatened with extinction. / Θα σας πούμε την ιστορία επιβίωσης των τελευταίων καμηλοπαρδάλεων, των βασιλισσών της σαβάνας. Πάμε πίσω στα τέλη του 2016, οπότε μάθαμε ότι η καμηλοπάρδαλη απειλείται με εξαφάνιση.

programme.title: The Red October Hunt: The True Story E2 (E) / Το Κυνήγι του Κόκκινου Οκτώβρη: η Αληθινή Ιστορία Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: The documentary reveals for the first time the incredible events behind the disappearance of the Soviet Nuclear submarine K-129 that disappeared on March 8, 1968, bringing the Soviet Union and the US to the brink of war. / Το ντοκιμαντέρ αποκαλύπτει για πρώτη φορά τα απίστευτα γεγονότα πίσω από την εξαφάνιση του σοβιετικού πυρηνικού υποβρυχίου Κ-129 που εξαφανίστηκε στις 8 Μαρτίου 1968, φέρνοντας τη Σοβιετική Ένωση και τις ΗΠΑ στα πρόθυρα του πολέμου.

programme.title: The cape of violence / Το Ακρωτήρι της Βίας
programme.desc: Police Officers Ali Shock and Brian Kypin, Cape Town, are investigating the murder of a young white woman. As all show, the murder was caused by the movement of a new, illegal substance, linked to the disappearance of black street children. (100) / Οι αστυνομικοί Άλι Σοκέλα και Μπράιαν Έπκιν, του Κέιπ Τάουν, διερευνούν τη δολοφονία μιας νεαρής λευκής γυναίκας. Όπως όλα δείχνουν, η δολοφονία προκλήθηκε από την κυκλοφορία μιας νέας, παράνομης ουσίας, που συνδέθηκε με την εξαφάνιση μαύρων παιδιών του δρόμου. (100)

programme.title: Small stories / Μικρές Ιστορίες
programme.desc: Apallou. A grandson returns to the village of his ancestors to overwinter. A grandfather returns from death to see his grandson one last time. A village is helpless to manage returns made out of love. / Apallou. Ένας εγγονός επιστρέφει στο χωριό των προγόνων του για να ξεχειμωνιάσει. Ένας παππούς επιστρέφει από τον θάνατο, για να δει για μια τελευταία φορά τον εγγονό του. Ένα χωριό είναι ανήμπορο να διαχειριστεί επιστροφές, που έγιναν από αγάπη.

programme.desc: Chelsea have lost just 8.3% of their Premier League games against Fulham, the joint-lowest loss rate one side has against another with a minimum of 20 meetings. programme.title: Practice 3 - FIA Formula 1 World Championship - Dutch GP - 2025
programme.desc: As FP3 finalizes Zandvoort setups, McLaren aim to pressure Red Bull’s home hero. Norris looks for a fourth win in five; Piastri to extend his nine-point lead. Verstappen’s home advantage looms. A narrow, historic circuit with limited overtaking makes FP3 data critical.

programme.title: Practice 1 - FIA Formula 1 World Championship - Dutch GP - 2025
programme.desc: The Dutch Grand Prix marks Round 15 of the 2025 FIA F1 World Championship season (#76), with Practice 1 opening the weekend at Zandvoort. It sets the stage for McLaren’s championship duel—Piastri (P1, 284 pts) vs Norris (P2, 275)—as they seek to extend their dominance over Verstappen (P3, 187). Strategy, setup, and initial pace take shape here.

programme.title: Practice 2 - FIA Formula 1 World Championship - Dutch GP - 2025
programme.desc: Free Practice 2 continues the evolution of setups, as Piastri and Norris hone their edge. McLaren arrive with four straight 1–2 finishes; Verstappen’s Zandvoort credentials—three straight home wins from pole—add home pressure. It’s a battle of balance and reliability ahead of qualifying.

programme.title: Main Race Qualifying - FIA Formula 1 World Championship - Dutch GP - 2025
programme.desc: Qualifying decides the grid at Zandvoort’s twisty, banked layout—known for rewarding pole positions only. McLaren’s front-row streak meets Verstappen’s home advantage. Piastri holds the championship lead by 9 points over Norris; both will push to control the race from the front.

programme.title: Main Race - Hungary Round - Moto 3 - 2025
programme.desc: The Moto3 race in Hungary covers 20 laps and is renowned for relentless pack racing. Riders slipstream and swap positions lap after lap, making every corner a potential overtaking spot. The smallest error can send a contender back through the field, while the boldest moves define the podium. With standard points to the top 15, every finish matters. A thrilling sprint finish is almost guaranteed, showcasing the stars of tomorrow.

programme.title: Qualifying - Hungary GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: MotoGP qualifying in Hungary decides the grid for both the Sprint and the Grand Prix. Riders battle across Q1 and Q2 in back-to-back 15-minute sessions, with Q1’s top two advancing. Slipstream tactics deleted laps for track limits, and last-second improvements create high drama. Pole position and front-row spots are crucial on Balaton Park’s narrow layout, setting the stage for a thrilling Sprint and Sunday showdown.

programme.title: Sprint Race - Hungary GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: The Tissot Sprint brings half-distance racing at full intensity. Thirteen laps of Balaton Park test riders with little time to recover mistakes. Points go to the top nine finishers (12-9-7-6-5-4-3-2-1), making every position count in the championship. Expect lightning starts, bold overtakes into the heavy braking zones, and a frantic dash to the flag as riders fight for momentum heading into the Grand Prix.

programme.title: Main Race - Hungary GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: The Hungarian Grand Prix main event delivers 26 laps, covering more than 105 km of pure racing action. The technical nature of Balaton Park punishes tyre wear and rewards consistent pace, making pit-wall strategy and rider discipline essential. Championship points for the top 15 are on offer, from 25 for the winner downward. Expect wheel-to-wheel fights, decisive braking moves, and a podium that could reshape the title battle.

programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Jeanguillaume vs Boraros / Borilački sport - MMA: Jeanguillaume vs Boraros
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: MMA SBC Odzaci
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Espanyol - Osasuna / Fudbal - Španska liga: Espanyol - Osasuna
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path set after the hand of Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team of Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspešnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - English League: Nottingham Forest - West Ham / Fudbal - Engleska liga: Nottingham Forest - West Ham
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Mozzart Bet Superliga: Vojvodina - TSC / Fudbal - Mozzart Bet Superliga: Vojvodina - TSC
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the sub-circuit principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the Red-White Titles to the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcioniše po dvokružnom principu takmičenju. Istoriju Superlige u najvećoj meri su obeležila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Istorijski gledano, po broju osvojenih titula crveno-beli do grada je uspešniji.

programme.title: Volleyball: Superliga of Serbia (F): TENT - UB, semifinals 1 / Odbojka: Superliga Srbije (Ž): TENT - Ub, polufinale 1
programme.desc: Enjoy with great matches of our volleyball players while competing for the best possible place in the Serbian Championship! Find out which from the team will take the title of the best female club in Serbia. / Uživajte uz sjajne mečeve naših odbojkašica dok se nadmeću za što bolje mesto u Prvenstvu Srbije! Saznajte koja će od ekipa poneti titulu najboljeg ženskog kluba u Srbiji.

programme.title: Košarka - KLS: Partizan Mozzart Bet - FMP Soccerbet, G3 / Košarka - KLS: Partizan Mozzart bet - FMP Soccerbet, G3
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Košarka - NBA liga: NBA Chasing History 1. deo
programme.desc: The sixth day of June of June 1946. years will change the basketball game forever. The teams are divided into an east and western conference and through 82 regular season, the regular season hunting one of the eight playoff positions. Conference champions are entering the large NBA final where in a series of a maximum of seven games decide on the new champion. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gde u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Borac - Sarajevo / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Borac - Sarajevo
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Košarka - ABA Liga: Partizan - Dubai, G3 / Košarka - ABA liga: Partizan - Dubai, G3
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - Croatian League: Osijek - Hajduk / Fudbal - Hrvatska liga: Osijek - Hajduk
programme.desc: The Croatian football league was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the competition system and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-circular form of the competition. The transition cup intended for the champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana Earth. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. The absolute recorder in the number of favorites achieved is the legend of Varteks Davor Vugrinec with 144 goals. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se menjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prelazni kup namenjen prvaku delo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo. Apsolutni rekorder po broju postignutih pogodaka legenda je Varteksa Davor Vugrinec sa 144 gola.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Worker - Velez / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Radnik - Velež
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Igokea - Red Star G2 / Košarka - ABA liga: Igokea - Crvena zvezda G2
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. programme.title: Skrij se
programme.desc: Juan Miranda is a Mexican farmer who became Bandit. His gang is made up of members of his family. John Mallory, a former Ira trainer, is a weapon expert. They meet in Mexico and intend to rob the banks together. The wishes of the traveling revolutionary dr. Villege decides to blow off a local bank. But on Juan's sadness (and John's joy), it turns out that the bank was a prison and the explosion free the closed revolutionaries. Suddenly they become Juan and John hero of the revolution! Although, of course, Juan would prefer money ... They soon come to a trace of government forces led by the cruel colonel Guttierez. Juan is caught. But just before the killing, he hears the famous John's voice - you come to save him with a dynamite ... Juan is liberated and accidentally finds himself in the middle of the revolution. He kills Tyrannian governor Don Jaime, and with John takes his peasants to the last attack on Guttierez and his army. Sergio Leone played with a series of interesting quotes, including Maa Cetung's quotes, which belong to an otherwise historical film as his actualization. Leone. / Juan Miranda je mehiški kmet, ki je postal bandit. Njegovo tolpo sestavljajo člani njegove družine. John Mallory, nekdanji pripradnik IRA, pa je strokovnjak za orožje. Srečata se v Mehiki in nameravata skupaj ropati banke.Na željo potujočega revolucionarja dr. Villege se John odloči, da bo razstrelil krajevno banko. Toda na Juanovo žalost (in Johnovo veselje) se izkaže, da je bila banka zapor, eksplozija pa osvobodi zaprte revolucionarje. Nenadoma postaneta Juan in John junaka revolucije! Čeprav bi imel Juan seveda raje denar ...Kmalu jima pridejo na sled vladne sile pod vodstvom krutega polkovnika Guttiereza. Juan je ujet. Toda tik pred usmrtitvijo zasliši znani Johnov glas ‒ pajdaš ga je prišel rešit z dinamitom ...Juan je osvobojen in se ponovno po naključju znajde sredi revolucije. Ubije tiranskega guvernerja Dona Jaimeja in z Johnom popelje kmete v zadnji napad na Guttiereza in njegovo vojsko.Sergio Leone se je poigral z vrsto zanimivimi citati, tudi s citati Maa Cetunga, ki sodijo v sicer zgodovinski film kot njegova aktualizacija.Film je nastajal kmalu po študentskih gibanjih leta 1968 in njihov vpliv je čutiti tudi pri Sergio Leoneju.

programme.title: Mali veliki vojak
programme.desc: In China, it was a dark time when the relentless war invaders were batting battles to satiate their aggressiveness. Millions have died; Whoever survived, however, had only two options: to kill or let him kill. The battalions of the Liang Lianas and Wei were dealing with bloody battles from dusk to dawn. Only two men remained: an infantry soldier Lianga and a hostile general from Wei. He survived the first because he could pretend to be dead; Even a false spear pours his body to make it look more real. He caught the wounded general, hoping that his ticket would be freedom. He would hand over the General to Liang's commander, would be dismissed from warfare and could return to a peaceful home life. The young general is lenient with an older soldier; But during the long journey, the husband is constantly arguing. / Na Kitajskem je bil temačen čas, ko so neusmiljeni vojni zavojevalci bíli bitke, da bi nasitili svojo napadalnost. Milijoni so umrli; kdor je preživel, pa je imel le dve možnosti: da ubije ali se pusti ubiti.Bataljoni sprtih dežel Liang in Wei so se spopadali v krvavih bitkah od mraka do zore. Ostala sta le dva moža: pehotni vojak Lianga ter sovražni general iz Weija. Prvi je preživel, ker se zna dobro pretvarjati, da je mrtev; celo lažna sulica mu prebada telo, da je videti bolj resnično. Ujel je ranjenega generala, v upanju, da bo to njegova vozovnica v svobodo.Generala bi predal poveljniku Lianga, bil bi razrešen vojskovanja in lahko bi se vrnil k mirnemu domačemu življenju. Mladi general je s starejšim vojakom prizanesljiv; a med dolgo potjo se moža nenehno prepirata.

programme.title: Football (M): HSV - St. Pauli, Bundesliga 2025/2026, Hamburg / Nogomet (M): HSV - St. Pauli, Bundesliga 2025/2026 , Hamburg
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. programme.title: Football (M): Noah - Olympia, Qualifications for Conference League 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Noah - Olimpija, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/26
programme.desc: Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season. / Od leta 2021 bodo nogometni navdušenci uživali v Konferenčni ligi Evrope, ki jo organizira UEFA. Ideja za to ligo se je pojavila leta 2015, vključuje pa nižje rangirane ekipe državnih prvenstev. Kvalifikacije so razdeljene na dva dela, po katerih bo v tekmovanje vstopilo 32 ekip, ki bodo razdeljene v osem skupin po štiri. 16 ekip bo napredovalo v osmino finala, nato v četrtfinale, polfinale in finale. Zmagovalec finalne tekme se bo uvrstil v Ligo Evrope v naslednji sezoni.

programme.title: Automotive: European Le Mans Series: highlights: Spa-Francorchamps / Avtomobilizem: European Le Mans Series: Vrhunci: Spa-Francorchamps
Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Young Sports Games: Split: 1. Day / Športne igre mladih: Split: 1. dan
programme.desc: Young sports games began in 1996 in Split, with the desire to enable all elementary and high school students to participate in organized sports competitions and other free activities during the summer. Young people's sports games encourage a way of life, which is based on understanding, friendship, solidarity and fair-play, as an alternative to all possible negative factors of today, which are markedly reflected in the population of children and youth. / Športne igre mladih so se začele leta 1996 v Splitu z željo, da bi vsem osnovnošolcem in srednješolcem omogočili sodelovanje v organiziranih športnih tekmovanjih in drugih brezplačnih dejavnostih med poletjem. Športne igre mladih spodbujajo način življenja, katerega temelji so razumevanje, prijateljstvo, solidarnost in fair-play, kot alternativo vsem mogočim negativnim dejavnikom današnjega časa, ki se izrazito odražajo na populaciji otrok in mladine.

programme.title: Football (M): Ostrava Banic - Celje, Qualifications for Conference League 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Banik Ostrava - Celje, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/2026
programme.desc: Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season. / Od leta 2021 bodo nogometni navdušenci uživali v Konferenčni ligi Evrope, ki jo organizira UEFA. Ideja za to ligo se je pojavila leta 2015, vključuje pa nižje rangirane ekipe državnih prvenstev. Kvalifikacije so razdeljene na dva dela, po katerih bo v tekmovanje vstopilo 32 ekip, ki bodo razdeljene v osem skupin po štiri. 16 ekip bo napredovalo v osmino finala, nato v četrtfinale, polfinale in finale. Zmagovalec finalne tekme se bo uvrstil v Ligo Evrope v naslednji sezoni.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: We bite science: preservation of the past - heritage science, Mon. / Ugriznimo znanost: Ohranjanje preteklosti - dediščinska znanost, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Meško Primož ... There are seven of the ten books in libraries and archives around the world, almost as acidic and lemon juice, so they will fail in the next 300 to 400 years. This applies to the paper they made after 1850. / R: Meško Primož... V knjižnicah in arhivih po svetu je sedem od desetih knjig skoraj tako kislih kot limonov sok, zato bodo v prihodnjih 300 do 400 letih propadle. To velja za papir, ki so ga izdelovali po letu 1850.
programme.desc: Why is it so sour? The paper they produced until 1850 lasts for 10 thousand years. What is today's paper? Plastic is often made as consumables for short -term use, but plastic objects are becoming part of our cultural heritage. How to keep them? Conservation of cultural heritage is energy wasteful. Will we have to decide what we keep and what is not? How do the heritage preservation affect climate change? / Zakaj je tako kisel? Papir, ki so ga proizvajali do leta 1850, pa zdrži 10 tisoč let. programme.title: Slovenian jazz scene: Artbeaters, 1/2, Mon. / Slovenska jazz scena: Artbeaters, 1/2, pon.
programme.desc: R: Zupe Igor ... Artbeaters consists of four young people, educated jazz musicians abroad: Peter Ugrin (violin), Aleš Ogrin (keyboards), Jan Gregorka (electric bass) and Anže Žurbi (drums). The ensemble combines the influences of traditional jazz, New Orleans, Swing, as well as the genres of contemporary funk, reggae, Drumnbas, House, Afro Beat and Jazz Rock in its repertoire. Their author's music would be best described as fusion jazz, the fusion of different musical styles with an emphasis on the main element of jazz - improvisation. Violin contributes greatly to their original sound, which is a fairly rare instrument among jazz ensembles. In Romania in May 2012, the band won the international jazz competition (6th International Jazz Competition), with 170 music groups from around the world participating. They will broadcast a clip that was made in the picturesque outside ambience of the old town center of Kranj. Editor of the Slovenian Jazz Scene Cycle: Daniel Celarec. / R: Zupe Igor... Artbeaters sestavljajo štirje mladi, v tujini izobraženi jazz glasbeniki: Peter Ugrin (violina), Aleš Ogrin (klaviature), Jan Gregorka (električni bas) in Anže Žurbi (bobni). Ansambel v svojem repertoarju združuje vplive tradicionalnega jazza, new orleansa, swinga, kot tudi zvrsti sodobnega funka, reggaeja, drumnbasa, housa, afro beata ter jazz rocka. Njihovo avtorsko glasbo bi najbolje opisali kot fusion jazz, zlitje različnih glasbenih stilov s poudarkom na glavnemu elementu jazza - improvizaciji. K njihovemu izvirnemu zvoku veliko prispeva violina, ki je med jazzovskimi zasedbami dokaj redek inštrument. Zasedba je v Romuniji meseca maja 2012 zmagala na mednarodnem jazzovskem tekmovanju (6. International Jazz Competition), na katerem je sodelovalo 170 glasbenih skupin iz celega sveta. Predvajali bodo posnetek, ki je nastal v slikovitem zunanjem ambientu starega mestnega jedra mesta Kranj. Urednik cikla oddaj Slovenska jazz scena: Daniel Celarec.

programme.title: Memories: Rudi Shelih, Mon. / Spomini: Rudi Šelih, pon.
programme.desc: This time we will listen to reputable lawyer Rudi Šelih, a longtime president and today an honorary member of the Slovenian Bar Association and the honorary vice -president of the International Bar Association. In 1929, he was born in a large family with eleven children in Konjice and the first part of his narrative is an interesting outline of the life and habits of a solid peasant family between the two wars, while also flashing Konjic, where his father was mayor for many years. The German occupation during the Second World War interfered with the family with Nazi prisons, interrogations and torture, concentration camps. Rudi became a young partisan, and everyone managed to survive the war. Just before the end of the war, his brother Ivan managed to escape from Auschwitz to the Russians, staying in their army and returning home only in 1947 - just before the outbreak of the informbureau, when the post -war time was greatly cut into the family. In 1951, four brothers, father and a series of relatives were imprisoned and interrogated for months, and older brother Ivan was sent to the Naked Island for several years, and the younger brother of Rudy Šelih, already a student of law at the time, were females and interrogation in accential prisons in Ljubljana and after a year in Celje. also (later in the same court can be repealed), sent for four years to the post -war Bileć camp. Later, as an internationally recognized lawyer, Rudi Šelih met with judges and prosecutors from post -war trials at home and around the world, as well as his lawyers and judges he had experienced in Bileća after the war - as his torturers. / Tokrat bomo prisluhnili uglednemu advokatu Rudiju Šelihu, dolgoletnemu predsedniku in danes častnemu članu Odvetniške zbornice Slovenije ter častnemu podpredsedniku Mednarodne odvetniške zbornice. Leta 1929 je bil rojen v veliki družini z enajstimi otroki v Konjicah in prvi del njegove pripovedi je zanimiv oris življenja in navad trdne kmečke družine v času med obema vojnama, hkrati pa življenjskega utripa Konjic, kjer je bil njegov oče veliko let tudi župan. Nemška okupacija med drugo svetovno vojno je posegla v družino z nacističnimi zapori, zasliševanji in mučenji, koncentracijskimi taborišči. Rudi je postal mlad partizan, vsem pa je uspelo vojno preživeti. Bratu Ivanu je tik pred koncem vojne uspelo iz Auschwitza prebegniti k Rusom, ostal je v njihovi armadi in se vrnil domov šele leta 1947 - tik pred izbruhom informbiroja, ko je povojni čas znova močno zarezal v družino. Leta 1951 so štiri brate, očeta in vrsto sorodnikov za več mesecev zaprli in jih zasliševali, starejši brat Ivan je bil po preživetih taboriščih za več let poslan na Goli otok, mlajšega brata Rudija Šeliha, takrat že študenta prava, pa so po letu dni samice in zasliševanj v Centalnih zaporih v Ljubljani in po letu dni v celjskem zaporu Stari pisker, kjer je na tamkajšnjem Okrožnem sodišču doživel tudi (kasneje na istem sodišču razveljavljeno) obsodbo, za štiri leta poslali v povojno taborišče Bileća. Pozneje se je Rudi Šelih, takrat že kot mednarodno priznan odvetnik, doma in po svetu srečal s sodniki in tožilci iz povojnih procesov, tudi svojega, pa tudi z odvetniki in sodniki, ki jih je po vojni doživel v Bileći - kot svoje mučitelje.

programme.title: Forgotten Slovenes: Sergei Masera, documentary, Mon. / Pozabljeni Slovenci: Sergej Mašera, dokumentarna oddaja, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Chok Radovan ... Sergei Mashera was a lieutenant of the battleship, an expert in ships and a national hero, in 1941 he died on a battleship in Boka Kotorska. / R: Čok Radovan... Sergej Mašera je bil poročnik bojne ladje, strokovnjak za ladijske topove in narodni heroj, leta 1941 je umrl na bojni ladji v Boki Kotorski.
programme.desc: Sergei Mashera (1912–1941) enrolled in 1929, when he graduated in Ljubljana, at the Maritime Academy of War in Dubrovnik. He completed the academy in 1932 as one of the best cadets. As he was attracted to artillery, he was refining Kotor in this area in Boka, and in Zemun, where he later served, he also wanted to pass the exam for a higher rank of battlefield. As an expert in ship cannons, he participated in the commission for the acquisition of the armaments for a destroyer Belgrade, to which he was assigned after his official reception into the fleet of the Kingdom of Yugoslavia. Just before World War II began, he was transferred to the Zagreb destroyer, at which he received the beginning of the April war. After the capitulation of the Yugoslav army, the destroyer was blown out so as not to come into the hands of the Italian Navy. Both officers - Sergei Masera and Milan Spasić - were the only ones staying on the ship and sinking with her. In the early 1970s, they were proclaimed national heroes. / Sergej Mašera (1912–1941) se je leta 1929, ko je v Ljubljani maturiral, vpisal na Vojno pomorsko akademijo v Dubrovniku. Akademijo je končal leta 1932 kot eden izmed najboljših kadetov. Ker ga je privlačilo topništvo, se je v Boki Kotorski izpopolnjeval na tem področju, v Zemunu, kjer je kasneje služboval, pa je želel opraviti izpit tudi za višji čin poročnika bojne ladje. Kot strokovnjak za ladijske topove je na Švedskem sodeloval v komisiji za prevzem oborožitve za rušilec Beograd, na katerega je bil dodeljen po njegovem uradnem sprejemu v floto Kraljevine Jugoslavije. Tik pred začetkom druge svetovne vojne je bil kot topniški častnik premeščen na rušilec Zagreb, na katerem je dočakal začetek aprilske vojne. Po kapitulaciji jugoslovanske vojske so rušilec razstrelili, da ne bi prišel v roke italijanski vojni mornarici. Oba častnika – Sergej Mašera in Milan Spasić – sta edina ostala na ladji in se skupaj z njo potopila. V začetku sedemdesetih let sta bila razglašena za narodna heroja.

programme.title: The Lord and Mrs. Smith / El Senyor i la Senyora Smith
programme.desc: John and Jane are a couple who have made a fortune thanks to their work: both are highly effective murderers. However, they are used by agencies that are competition. The Smith discover a new democio source in marriage when they hire them to kill the other. / John i Jane son una parella que ha fet fortuna gràcies a la seva feina: tots dos son assassins altament eficaços. Tot i això, estan emprats per agències que son competència. Els Smith descobreixen una nova font democio en el matrimoni quan els contracten per matar-se lun a laltre.

programme.title: Be Happy!
programme.desc: The MGMC, a music group, performs in London and among their attendees are Peter and Mika, David and Coco. This crazy group along with other protagonists live delusional situations in Mallorca, when they decide to make a getaway to move away from the dramas, director Ventura Pons (Miss Dalí) directs this crazy comedy in the form of a musical. The production shows the different situations of the life of the protagonists and their way of solving them, the film was shot in Mallorca and, despite being a Spanish production, is completely shot in English. / Els MGMC, un grup de música, actua a Londres i entre els seus assistents es troben Peter i Mika, David i Coco. Aquest esbojarrat grup juntament amb altres protagonistes viuen situacions delirants a Mallorca, quan decideixen fer una escapada per allunyar-se dels drames.El director Ventura Pons (Miss Dalí) dirigeix ​​aquesta esbojarrada comèdia en forma de musical. La produccio mostra les diferents situacions de la vida dels protagonistes i la seva forma de solucionar-los.La pel·lícula va ser rodada a Mallorca i, tot i ser una produccio espanyola, està rodada completament en anglès.

programme.title: White on white: Limits / Blanc sobre blanc: Límits
programme.desc: The Saproxima program in the open of two artists and investigates how they perceive beauty or how the materials they use. A mes, entra al taller de lartista i descobreix el seu espai de treball, autèntic indret de creacio.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fúria on the road / Mad Max: Fúria a la carretera
programme.desc: Max Rockansky Turns Sun by the world trying to survive. However, he ends up being part of a group, led by a furious rebel, which flees from the fury of the immortan Joe Tirara. For this occasion, Miller made clear a premise: the ribbon had to be as colorful and beautiful as possible with the purpose of differentiating it from other postpocalyptic films. The result was a frenetic rhythm movie, full of rampant daccio and wild violence. / Max Rockatansky volta sol pel mon tractant de sobreviure. No obstant, acaba formant part dun grup, liderat per una rebel anomenada Furiosa, que fuig de la fúria del tirà Immortan Joe.30 anys despres que George Miller presentara Mad Max mes enllà de la cúpula del tro, el director australià va recuperar el boig Max, un antic policia que sobreviu en la carretera despres duna guerra termonuclear que va convertir la Terra en un erm. Per aquesta ocasio, Miller va deixar clara una premissa: la cinta havia de ser tan colorida i bella com fos possible amb lobjectiu de diferenciar-la daltres films postapocalíptics. El resultat va ser una pel·lícula de ritme frenètic, plena daccio desenfrenada i violència salvatge.

programme.title: Goldrausch in Alaska
programme.desc: The price for fuel has reached a record high. Spare parts are also very expensive. And the mine bosses have to cattle with delivery. That means: the teams are facing a hard season. But Parker Schnabel cannot be got down by the adverse circumstances. The 27-year-old secures more land in the Yukon than ever before. And he wants to open up a new claim in Alaska. Meanwhile, Tony Beets is bundle at the Paradise Hill. Parker's long-term rival strives for a 5000 ounces. And Fred Lewis takes out a loan to finance the treasure hunt in the nearby Dawson City. Are the efforts of the gold graves rewarded? The Wild West was yesterday, but gold fever is back. With a fixed goal in mind, six men in the wilderness of Alaska take their fate into their own hands: on a separated Claim near the Canadian border, they want to shrink for gold. Together with his father Jack, a real gold rush veteran, Todd Hoffman gathered a handful of motivated man. The hope for wealth, fame and fist -sized nuggets drives them to high performance. But what depends on the wildly romantic realization of a childhood dream is a tough work paired with high risk: wild barn, extreme weather and bitter exchanges await the treasure hunters in a god -forgiving area. / Der Preis fur Treibstoff hat ein Rekordhoch erreicht. Ersatzteile sind ebenfalls sehr teuer. Und die Minenbosse haben mit Lieferengpassen zu kampfen. Das bedeutet: Den Teams steht eine harte Saison bevor. Doch Parker Schnabel lasst sich von den widrigen Umstanden nicht unterkriegen. Der 27-Jahrige sichert sich im Yukon mehr Grund und Boden als jemals zuvor. Und er will in Alaska einen neuen Claim erschliessen. Tony Beets bundelt derweil seine Krafte am Paradise Hill. Parkers Langzeit-Rivale strebt dort eine Ausbeute von 5000 Unzen an. Und Fred Lewis nimmt einen Kredit auf, um die Schatzsuche in der Nahe von Dawson City zu finanzieren. Werden die Anstrengungen der Goldgraber belohnt?Der Wilde Westen war gestern, doch das Goldfieber ist zuruck. Mit einem festen Ziel vor Augen, nehmen sechs Manner in der Wildnis Alaskas ihr Schicksal selbst in die Hand: Auf einem abgeschiedenen Claim nahe der kanadischen Grenze wollen sie nach Gold schurfen. Zusammen mit seinem Vater Jack, einem echten Goldrausch-Veteran, hat Todd Hoffman eine Handvoll motivierter Manner um sich versammelt. Die Hoffnung auf Reichtum, Ruhm und faustgrosse Nuggets treibt sie dabei zu Hochstleistungen an. Doch was sich nach der wildromantischen Verwirklichung eines Kindheitstraums anhort, ist knuppelharte Arbeit gepaart mit hohem Risiko: Wildlebende Baren, extreme Witterung und herbe Enttauschungen warten auf die Schatzsucher in einer gottverlassenen Gegend.

With heavy rats and huge hydraulic suckers, the experts search for the seabed. The exhausting expeditions are not unusual and very few do the big Reibach. / Um die verlorene Zeit durch die Sturm-Zwangspause wieder rein zu holen, setzt Shawn auf kraftezehrende Überstunden. Die Gegend ist beruhmt fur ihre Goldvorkommen, die uber Millionen Jahre vom Schmelzwasser der Gletscher angeschwemmt wurden. programme.title: NZZ Format
programme.sub-title: Eltern dank Eizellspende - Furs Wunschkind ins Ausland
programme.desc: In the course of social change, many women postpone their desire to have children at a later time, which often leads to difficulties in reception. Nowadays, every 30th baby is generated with the help of artificial fertilization. However, the Swiss reproductive medication law deals unevenly. If a man is non -fertile, a sperm donation can be considered. This has been legal in Switzerland since 2001 as long as the donation is not anonymous. In contrast, the egg donation for women, whose egg reserve is exhausted by early menopause, illness or age, is punishable in Switzerland. More and more women are therefore looking for support abroad. Many trips for their desire to have children to Spain and the Czech Republic, as there are a lot of egg donors for grouting. However, the donation in these countries is exclusively anonymous, which makes it impossible for the child to identify his genetic mother. How can we use the topic to deal with the topic of egg donation in Switzerland? / Im Zuge des gesellschaftlichen Wandels verschieben viele Frauen ihren Kinderwunsch auf einen spateren Zeitpunkt, was oft zu Schwierigkeiten bei der Empfangnis fuhrt. Heutzutage wird jedes 30. Baby mithilfe kunstlicher Befruchtung gezeugt. Allerdings behandelt das Schweizer Fortpflanzungsmedizingesetz Manner und Frauen ungleich. Wenn ein Mann zeugungsunfahig ist, kann eine Samenspende in Betracht gezogen werden. In der Schweiz ist das seit 2001 legal, solange die Spende nicht anonym erfolgt. Im Gegensatz dazu steht die Eizellspende fur Frauen, deren Eizellreserve durch vorzeitige Wechseljahre, Krankheit oder Alter erschopft ist, in der Schweiz unter Strafe. Immer mehr Frauen suchen daher im Ausland Unterstutzung. Viele reisen fur ihren Kinderwunsch nach Spanien und Tschechien, da dort sehr viele Eizellspenderinnen zur Verfugung stehen. Allerdings erfolgt die Spende in diesen Landern ausschliesslich anonym, was es dem Kind spater unmoglich macht, seine genetische Mutter zu identifizieren. Wie konnen wir in der Schweiz zukunftig verantwortungsbewusst mit dem Thema Eizellspende umgehen?NZZ Format die Dok-Sendung der NZZ - erzahlt moderne Geschichten mit journalistischer Relevanz aus den Bereichen World-Affairs, Gesellschaftspolitik, Kultur und Wissenschaft.

programme.title: Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: In this episode, the aquarium professionals build an underwater world for the Bellagio Hotel in Las Vegas. There, an exhibition on the topic "under the ocean" is opened in a short time. The managers of the luxury hostel have ordered two huge pools with 5700 liters of water from the professional craftsmen, which form a walk-in tunnel in the main course. The construction delivers super cool photo motifs. Due to the LED lighting and reflective film, when looking at the colorful tropical fish, you have the impression that you are most large for hours on the sea floor, large, bigger! Commercial room aquariums are also nice, but Wayde King and his partner Brett Raymer have little to do with 10 liter basins. Your specialty are breathtaking underwater worlds! From the octagonal eco system with murans and stingrays over the telephone booth aquarium to the shark tank for the doctor's practice: there is almost no idea that the boys do not dare to do. And their super aquariums not only like the underwater residents very well, but also the audience. Wherever the board and wayde always pretend to the public, people do not get out of amazement / In dieser Folge bauen die Aquarium-Profis eine Unterwasserwelt fur das Bellagio-Hotel in Las Vegas. Dort wird in Kurze eine Ausstellung zum Thema "Unter dem Ozean" eroffnet. Die Manager der Luxusherberge haben bei den Profi-Handwerkern zwei riesige Becken mit jeweils 5700 Litern Wasser bestellt, die im Hauptgang einen begehbaren Tunnel bilden. Die Konstruktion liefert supercoole Fotomotive. Denn aufgrund der LED-Beleuchtung und reflektierender Folie hat man beim Betrachten der bunten Tropenfische den Eindruck, man stunde direkt auf dem Meeresgrund.Gross, grosser, am grossten! Handelsubliche Zimmer-Aquarien sind auch nett, doch mit 10 Liter-Becken haben Wayde King und sein Partner Brett Raymer wenig am Hut. Ihr Spezialgebiet sind atemberaubende Unterwasserwelten! Vom achteckigen Öko-System mit Muranen und Stachelrochen uber das Telefonzellen-Aquarium bis zum Haifisch-Tank fur die Arzt-Praxis: Es gibt fast keine Idee, an die sich die Jungs nicht herantrauen.Dementsprechend lautet das Motto der beiden New Yorker: Wovon andere traumen, setzen wir in die Tat um! Und ihre Super-Aquarien gefallen nicht nur den Unterwasser-Bewohnern ausgesprochen gut, sondern auch dem Publikum.Wo immer Brett und Wayde ihrer beeindruckenden Spezialanfertigungen der Öffentlichkeit prasentieren, kommen die Leute aus dem Staunen nicht heraus

programme.title: Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: Rick looks at a very valuable Pokemon collection. In addition, the Harrison is offered a table lighter in the form of a clock from 1926. In the time of the "great depression", the United States was almost flooded with pawns in which humans put their belongings in payment to get cash quickly and unurocratic. The depression went, the idea was preserved. The reality series "The three from the Pfandhaus" accompanies the Harrison family, which has been running such a pawn house in Las Vegas since 1988. The spectators can experience what unusual objects go with the Harrison's over the counter and how difficult it is for company grans Richard Harrison, his son Rick and his son Corey to shake the value of things. In addition to historical machines, weapons from the Second World War, rare autographs from the 1950s and computers from the eighties, there can also be a luxury classic car. / Rick sieht sich eine sehr wertvolle Pokemon-Sammlung an. Ausserdem wird den Harrisons ein Tischfeuerzeug in Form einer Uhr von 1926 angeboten.In der Zeit der "Grossen Depression" wurden die USA geradezu uberschwemmt mit Pfandleihhausern, in denen Menschen ihre Habseligkeiten in Zahlung gaben, um schnell und unburokratisch an Bargeld zu kommen. Die Depression ging, die Idee blieb erhalten. Die Realityserie "Die Drei vom Pfandhaus" begleitet Familie Harrison, die seit 1988 in Las Vegas ein solches Pfandleihhaus betreibt. Die Zuschauer konnen erleben, welch ungewohnliche Objekte bei den Harrisons uber den Ladentisch gehen und wie schwierig es fur Firmengrunder Richard Harrison, seinen Sohn Rick und dessen Sohn Corey manchmal ist, den Wert der Dinge zu schatzen. Neben historischen Automaten, Waffen aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg, seltenen Autogrammen aus den 50er Jahren und Computern aus den Achtzigern kann da auch schon mal ein Luxus-Oldtimer dabei sein.

programme.desc: Rick looks at a train from the so -called "gold -plated age", but is not sure whether he will find a buyer for this. In the time of the "great depression", the United States was almost flooded with pawns in which humans put their belongings in payment to get cash quickly and unurocratic. The depression went, the idea was preserved. The reality series "The three from the Pfandhaus" accompanies the Harrison family, which has been running such a pawn house in Las Vegas since 1988. The spectators can experience what unusual objects go with the Harrison's over the counter and how difficult it is for company grans Richard Harrison, his son Rick and his son Corey to shake the value of things. Die Depression ging, die Idee blieb erhalten. Die Realityserie "Die Drei vom Pfandhaus" begleitet Familie Harrison, die seit 1988 in Las Vegas ein solches Pfandleihhaus betreibt. programme.title: Arena
programme.sub-title: What to do about femicides? / Was tun gegen Femizide?
programme.desc: In mid-August, a man in the canton of Neuchâtel dipped his ex-partner and the two daughter together. It is just one of numerous crops of women who have been in Switzerland since the beginning of the year. In view of the increasing number of victims, the Federal Buro for Equality speaks of a "worrying situation". The Federal Council has adopted a national action plan with 44 measures to obtain violence against women. This autumn, the federal government is also launching a national sensitization campaign. But are the measures already decided enough? Or does politics have to do more in the fight against gender-specific violence? Not in all cantons there are women's house. They offer protection for women and children affected by violence. Do you need more women's house and a stronger financial support of such offers? Or does politics have to start with the punishments for the tauters? Sandro Brotz welcomed to these questions on August 29, 2025 in the «Arena»:- Tamara Funiciello, Nationalrat Sp/Be;- Barbara Steinemann, Nationalrat SVP/ZH;- Silvia Vetsch, Bottom Head of St. Gallen; and Frank Urbaniok, Professor for Forensic Psychiatry. In addition, in the studio:- Manuel Niederhauser, Head of Threatening and Risk Management Cantonal Police St. Gallen. / Mitte August totet ein Mann im Kanton Neuenburg seine Ex-Partnerin und die beiden gemeinsamen Tochter. Es ist nur eines von zahlreichen Totungsdelikten an Frauen, die seit Anfang Jahr in der Schweiz verubt wurden. Angesichts der steigenden Opferzahlen spricht das Eidgenossische Buro fur Gleichstellung von einer «besorgniserregenden Situation».Im Nachgang an die Ratifizierung der sogenannten Istanbul-Konvention hat der Bundesrat einen nationalen Aktionsplan mit 44 Massnahmen zur Bekampfung von Gewalt gegen Frauen verabschiedet. Diesen Herbst lanciert der Bund zudem eine nationale Sensibilisierungskampagne. Doch reichen die bereits beschlossenen Massnahmen aus? Oder muss die Politik mehr tun im Kampf gegen geschlechtsspezifische Gewalt?Nicht in allen Kantonen gibt es FrauenhauserEine wichtige Funktion ubernehmen auch die 22 Frauen- und Madchenhauser in der Schweiz. Sie bieten Schutz fur Frauen und Kinder, die von Gewalt betroffen sind. Braucht es mehr Frauenhauser und eine starkere finanzielle Unterstutzung solcher Angebote? Oder muss die Politik viel eher bei den Strafen fur die Tater ansetzen?Zu diesen Fragen begrusst Sandro Brotz am 29. August 2025 in der «Arena»:- Tamara Funiciello, Nationalratin SP/BE;- Barbara Steinemann, Nationalratin SVP/ZH;- Silvia Vetsch, Geschaftsleiterin Frauenhaus St. Gallen; und- Frank Urbaniok, Professor fur Forensische Psychiatrie.Ausserdem im Studio:- Manuel Niederhauser, Leiter Bedrohungs- und Risikomanagement Kantonspolizei St. Gallen.

programme.title: Einfach retour
programme.sub-title: Jan in the middle of the Hells Angels / Jan in mitten der Hells Angels
programme.desc: It is the last stage: Jan starts in Tarifa, in the Suden Spain - where the Mediterranean hits the Atlantic. From Tarifa, Jan is supposed to find his way back to Switzerland with just 100 euros in pack and without a smartphone. What follows, is a journey through the shimmering heat of Spain. Marbella, Málaga, Madrid - it could be vacation. But Jan has no time for Siesta: he fights for every kilometer. Car stop sometimes works. But suddenly the journey drifts in a different direction: Jan Gerat in the middle of the world of the biker gang. And ends up in the Hells Angels clubhouse without warning. He spends the night in a secret place, between machines and men, which are better not to do, and the jerk trip becomes a sample test. The clock ticks mercilessly. And the money? Will be scarce. What Jan saves is his talent for improvisation: With a brush and paper, he creates works of art that open new ground. Thanks to people who do not question, but simply buy. The last night: a tent, somewhere in nowhere. But the longed -for calm fails - a wild animal shreds Jans backpack, eats the provisions. The last nerve lies blank. A few hours before the finish. Zurich calls - time runs. Is Jan still doing it - or is he experiencing a failure on the home stretch for the first time? / Es ist die letzte Etappe: Jan startet in Tarifa, ganz im Suden Spaniens - dort, wo das Mittelmeer auf den Atlantik trifft. Von Tarifa soll Jan mit nur 100 Euro in Gepack und ohne Smartphone den Weg zuruck in die Schweiz finden.Was folgt, ist eine Reise durch die flirrende Hitze Spaniens. Marbella, Málaga, Madrid - es konnten Ferien sein. Doch Jan hat keine Zeit fur Siesta: Er kampft um jeden Kilometer. Autostopp funktioniert manchmal. Doch plotzlich driftet die Reise in eine andere Richtung: Jan gerat mitten in die Welt der Biker-Gangs. Und landet ohne Vorwarnung im Clubhaus der Hells Angels. Die Nacht verbringt er an einem geheimen Ort, zwischen Maschinen und Mannern, die man besser nicht duzt.Die Ruckreise wird zur Zerreissprobe. Die Uhr tickt erbarmungslos. Und das Geld? Wird knapp. Was Jan rettet, ist sein Improvisationstalent: Mit Pinsel und Papier schafft er Kunstwerke, die ihm neue Wege offnen. Dank Menschen, die nichts hinterfragen, sondern einfach kaufen. Die letzte Nacht: ein Zelt, irgendwo im Nirgendwo. Doch die ersehnte Ruhe bleibt aus - ein wildes Tier zerfetzt Jans Rucksack, frisst den Proviant. Der letzte Nerv liegt blank. Wenige Stunden vor dem Ziel. Zurich ruft - die Zeit lauft. Schafft es Jan noch - oder erlebt er bei «Einfach Retour» zum ersten Mal ein Scheitern auf der Zielgeraden?

programme.title: James Bond 007 - In todlicher Mission
programme.desc: Before Albania, a British spy ship with a secret and highly sensitive electronic device on board has been sunk through a water bomb. The Russians were a long time ago behind the steering weapons computer. So the former British naval officer and marine archaologist Sir Timothy Havelock get the order with his yacht to locate the wreck and recover or destroy the computer. But Havelock and his wife fall victim to an assassination attempt. Now the British secret service switches its agent James Bond into the risky company. 007, just escaping a spectacular murder attack, feels about Midsmann in Madrid and Cortina Dampezzo after breakneck chase to the Reeder-Konig Kristatos, who tries to prevent him from rescue the highly secret. Bond finds Bond at the shady smuggler boss Columbo and Melina Havelock, the beautiful daughter of the murdered scientist, who wants to take the death of her parents. The agent and its compromised in dangerous adventures. This scene from “For Your Eyes Only” wrote cinema history. She is just one of many funny coming up in the twelfth bond adventure that director John Glen has tailored to the main actor Roger Moore. In addition to tricks, stunts and elaborate action, landscapes and sex appeal also play an important role this time. But everything is more manner and ironic than in more early Bond films, and femininity no longer occurs in the form of anonymous chorus girls. Bonds players are the dangerous-thone carole bouquet as revenge angel Melina and Lynn-Holly Johnson as ice skating artist Bibi.Kristatos, Bonds adversary in the murdered race for the rescue of a sunken news system, nested Shakespeare actor Julian Glover. Topol, the singing milk man from "Anatevka", plays the smuggler Columbo, which becomes the agent. The plot comes from a short story that Ian Fleming published in 1960 in his eighth bond book “For Your Eyes Only”. / Vor der Kuste Albaniens ist ein britisches Spionageschiff mit einem geheimen und hoch empfindlichen elektronischen Gerat an Bord durch eine Wasserbombe versenkt worden. Hinter dem Lenkwaffencomputer sind die Russen schon lange her. Also erhalt der ehemalige britische Marineoffizier und Meeresarchaologe Sir Timothy Havelock die Order, mit seiner Jacht das Wrack zu orten und den Computer zu bergen oder zu vernichten. Doch Havelock und seine Frau fallen einem Attentat zum Opfer.Jetzt schaltet der britische Geheimdienst seinen Agenten James Bond in das riskante Unternehmen ein. 007, gerade erst einem spektakularen Mordanschlag entkommen, tastet sich uber Mittelsmanner in Madrid und Cortina dAmpezzo nach halsbrecherischen Verfolgungsjagden an den Reeder-Konig Kristatos heran, der ihn von der Bergung des hoch geheimen Gerats abzuhalten sucht. Unterstutzung findet Bond beim zwielichtigen Schmugglerboss Columbo und bei Melina Havelock , der schonen Tochter des ermordeten Wissenschaftlers, die den Tod ihrer Eltern rachen will. Zu Land und unter Wasser geraten der Agent und seine Verbundeten in gefahrliche Abenteuer.Margaret Thatcher, Englands «Eiserne Lady» und fruhere Premierministerin, spricht in ihrer Kuche am roten Telefon mit James Bond. Diese Szene aus «For Your Eyes Only» hat Kinogeschichte geschrieben. Sie ist nur einer von vielen witzigen Einfallen im zwolften Bond-Abenteuer, das Regisseur John Glen ganz auf Hauptdarsteller Roger Moore zugeschnitten hat. Neben Tricks, Stunts und aufwendiger Action spielen auch diesmal Landschaften und Sex-Appeal eine wichtige Rolle. Aber alles ist manierlicher und ironischer als in fruheren Bond-Filmen, und die Weiblichkeit tritt nicht mehr in Form anonymer Chorus-Girls auf. Bonds Gespielinnen sind die gefahrlich-schone Carole Bouquet als Racheengel Melina und Lynn-Holly Johnson als Eislaufkunstlerin Bibi.Kristatos, Bonds Widersacher im morderischen Wettlauf um die Bergung eines versenkten Nachrichtensystems, verkorpert Shakespeare-Darsteller Julian Glover. Topol, der singende Milchmann aus «Anatevka», spielt den Schmuggler Columbo, der zum Verbundeten des Agenten wird. Die Handlung entstammt einer Kurzgeschichte, die Ian Fleming 1960 in seinem achten Bond-Buch «For Your Eyes Only» veroffentlicht hat.

"You only live twice" ("You only live twice") was the funfting James Bond film and a little more extravagant than his process. A mini -helicopter and a technically pimped convertible belong to the technical gadgets of the film. Even before the large Ninja wave, Ninja-Kampfer were already used here. The script comes from none other than the English writer Roald Dahl. With "You only live twice" Sean Connery actually wanted to say goodbye to the James Bond role; However, he then had him committed again for “Diamonds Are Forever” and finally moved to “Never Say Never Again” for a final assignment. / Als amerikanische und russische Raumschiffe auf ungewohnliche Weise gekapert werden, verdachtigen Washington und Moskau sich gegenseitig. Der britische Geheimdienst glaubt, es besser zu wissen, und so kommt Agent 007 alias James Bond zu einem neuen brisanten Auftrag. Zunachst wird er zum Schein ermordet und feierlich auf See bestattet, um das Verbrechersyndikat Spectre zu tauschen. In Wirklichkeit jedoch begibt er sich hochst lebendig nach Tokio, wo er mit aufregenden Schonheiten wie den Damen Aki und Mrs. Brandt zusammentrifft.In Japans Geheimdienstchef «Tiger» Tanaka findet er einen Verbundeten, der ebenfalls mit allen Wassern gewaschen ist. Bei einem abenteuerlichen Erkundungsflug gerat Bond in eine wilde Helikopterschlacht und entdeckt das Geheimnis eines erloschenen Vulkans. In diesem Krater hat Bosewicht Ernst Stavro Blofeld sein gut getarntes Hauptquartier eingerichtet. Von dort schickt er Raketen aus, die amerikanische und russische Raumkapseln «verschlucken» konnen, alles mit dem Ziel, die Supermachte in einen neuen Weltkrieg zu sturzen. Das kann nur James Bond verhindern.«Man lebt nur zweimal» («You Only Live Twice») war der funfte James-Bond-Film und noch ein bisschen extravaganter als seine Vorganger. Ein Minihelikopter und ein technisch aufgemotztes Cabriolet gehorten zu den technischen Gadgets des Films. Noch vor der grossen Ninja-Welle kamen hier bereits Ninja-Kampfer zum Einsatz. Doch plotzlich driftet die Reise in eine andere Richtung: Jan gerat mitten in die Welt der Biker-Gangs. Und landet ohne Vorwarnung im Clubhaus der Hells Angels. Wird knapp. Was Jan rettet, ist sein Improvisationstalent: Mit Pinsel und Papier schafft er Kunstwerke, die ihm neue Wege offnen. Dank Menschen, die nichts hinterfragen, sondern einfach kaufen. Die letzte Nacht: ein Zelt, irgendwo im Nirgendwo. Doch die ersehnte Ruhe bleibt aus - ein wildes Tier zerfetzt Jans Rucksack, frisst den Proviant. Der letzte Nerv liegt blank. Wenige Stunden vor dem Ziel. Zurich ruft - die Zeit lauft. Schafft es Jan noch - oder erlebt er bei «Einfach Retour» zum ersten Mal ein Scheitern auf der Zielgeraden?

programme.title: Monobloc
programme.desc: The documentary filmmaker and Grimme prize striker Hauke ​​Wendler follows the diverse traces of the monobloc of Europe Uber North America, to the slums in Brazil to the megastades of India and the Savanna of Uganda. He speaks to people whose life are characterized by this stackable, mostly white plastic chair and raises the question: What do you actually need to be happily? A history -critical object history between functionality and protective, capitalism and participation, consumption and recycling. / Der Dokumentarfilmer und Grimmepreistrager Hauke Wendler folgt den vielfaltigen Spuren des Monobloc von Europa uber Nordamerika, in die Slums in Brasilien bis in die Megastadte Indiens und die Savanne Ugandas. Er spricht mit Menschen, deren Leben von diesem stapelbaren, meist weissen Plastikstuhl gepragt sind und wirft dabei die Frage auf: Was braucht man eigentlich, um glucklich zu sein? Eine globalisierungskritische Objektgeschichte zwischen Funktionalitat und Schonheit, Kapitalismus und Teilhabe, Konsum und Recycling.Erstausstrahlung: 26.02.2023

programme.desc: The “Tagesschau” of Swiss television has been providing the news look since 1953. Over the years, the show has been adapted again and again - to the technological developments, but above all to the public's needs. The aim is to bring the most important topics at home and abroad every evening. Which domestic debates and international conflicts prompted the reporting at the time - and which of them are still doing it today? The view of the archive offers the possibility of climbing, classifying and remembering. / Die «Tagesschau» des Schweizer Fernsehens liefert seit 1953 allabendlich den Nachrichtenuberblick. Im Laufe der Jahre wurde die Sendung immer wieder angepasst - an die technologischen Entwicklungen, vor allem aber an die Bedurfnisse des Publikums. Gleich geblieben ist der Anspruch, jeden Abend die wichtigsten Themen im In- und Ausland kurz und verstandlich aufzubereiten.Die «Tagesschau vor 20 Jahren» bietet einen Nachrichtenruckblick in die jungere Geschichte: Welche Themen bewegten heute vor exakt 20 Jahren?
